jobs.title: Social Media Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Social Media Manager (f/m/d)

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Sharing this story with the world is just as important as the science and engineering behind it.

We're looking for a creative, proactive, and digitally savvy Social Media Manager to build and grow our social media presence, starting with LinkedIn. As our first dedicated social media hire, you'll have the opportunity to establish our social media strategy, develop a consistent content engine, and bring Focused Energy's innovations, people, and progress to life for audiences around the world.

You'll work closely with our Communications team and subject-matter experts across science, engineering, and business to turn complex technical developments into engaging, accessible content. From employer branding and thought leadership to company milestones and community engagement, you'll help shape how the world sees and connects with Focused Energy.

This is an exciting opportunity to build something from the ground up, take ownership of growing digital channels, and help amplify the story of a company working at the forefront of clean energy innovation.

What You'll Do

  • Own Our Social Media Presence: Lead the day-to-day strategy, planning, and execution of Focused Energy's LinkedIn presence, including content development, publishing cadence, and channel growth.

  • Build a Scalable Content Strategy: Establish and maintain an editorial calendar, repeatable content formats, and workflows that keep our social channels consistent, engaging, and aligned with company priorities.

  • Bring Our Story to Life: Partner with the Digital Content Creator and internal subject-matter experts to transform complex scientific, technical, and business developments into compelling content that resonates with external audiences.

  • Drive Employer Branding and Thought Leadership: Develop content that highlights our people, culture, technical expertise, company milestones, partnerships, and innovations to strengthen our reputation and support talent attraction.

  • Grow and Engage Our Community: Manage day-to-day community interactions, responding to followers, candidates, partners, and other audiences in a timely, authentic, and on-brand manner.

  • Explore New Opportunities: Evaluate emerging platforms and additional social channels, making recommendations on where and how Focused Energy should expand its digital presence.

  • Measure and Optimize Performance: Track key social media metrics, analyze audience engagement and content performance, and use insights to continuously improve our strategy, formats, and publishing approach.

  • Support Campaigns and Key Initiatives: Coordinate social media activity around company announcements, events, product and technology milestones, partnerships, and recruiting campaigns.

  • Maintain Brand and Content Standards: Ensure all published content reflects Focused Energy's voice, brand identity, and communication standards, working with the appropriate stakeholders to validate scientific accuracy and manage sensitive topics.

  • Support Paid and Organic Social Activity: Execute organic social initiatives and contribute to paid social campaigns within approved strategies and budgets.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring hands-on experience managing social media channels for a company, brand, startup, or organization, with a strong understanding of LinkedIn and its role in B2B marketing, employer branding, and thought leadership.

  • You have a strong grasp of social media strategy, content marketing, audience engagement, and the platform mechanics that drive visibility and growth.

  • You're an excellent writer and storyteller who knows how to turn complex ideas, technical information, and company updates into clear, engaging content for external audiences.

  • You have experience building editorial calendars, managing publishing schedules, and creating repeatable content processes that balance proactive planning with real-time opportunities.

  • You're comfortable using social media scheduling, publishing, and analytics tools to monitor performance, report on results, and optimize content. Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or similar paid social platforms is a plus.

  • You bring a creative mindset and an eye for what makes content relevant, compelling, and shareable, with an understanding of how visual and video content can strengthen social storytelling.

  • You're proactive and self-directed, comfortable building a function from the ground up while keeping leadership informed and seeking alignment on larger strategic decisions.

  • You're a strong collaborator who can build relationships across different teams, engage subject-matter experts, and make it easy for colleagues to contribute their knowledge and stories.

  • You demonstrate sound judgment and attention to detail, particularly when communicating technical developments, company progress, and potentially sensitive information publicly.

  • You're curious, adaptable, and excited by the opportunity to help tell the story of a company pushing the boundaries of science, technology, and clean energy.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.title: Lead Learning & Development Partner
jobs.description:
Lead Learning & Development Partner

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

About The Role

As our Lead Learning & Development Partner, you'll be the first dedicated L&D hire at Focused Energy and will have the opportunity to build the function from the ground up. This is a build from zero, sequenced for impact rather than a catalogue of offerings. You'll own manager development, a shared picture of the skills the organization has and needs, the learning infrastructure that makes learning findable and current, successor readiness for the roles that matter most, and the knowledge management work that keeps technical and scientific expertise from leaving with the person who holds it.

You'll work closely with People Business Partners, functional leads, People Operations, and the Strategic People Projects Partner, and you'll partner with subject matter experts across the organization as co-authors of the learning that translates deep technical and scientific knowledge into something usable by the people who need it.

This is a highly hands on role. We're looking for someone who brings a strong point of view, can operate independently, and is excited to determine what great learning looks like at Focused Energy, and then make it happen.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and own the L&D function at Focused Energy, from diagnosing organizational needs through designing, delivering, and continuously improving learning programs.

Senior Customer Solutions Engineer

Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role.

Responsibilities

  • System Integration: Collaborate with our internal Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Operational teams to understand and deliver Plume's solutions within a customer's ecosystem. You'll work to integrate our solutions into their existing BSS/OSS, CRM, ticketing, and AI platforms using APIs and other integration methods.
  • Sales Enablement: Work closely with the sales organization to drive revenue, achieve sales quotas, and contribute to the overall growth of the business.
  • Presentations & Events: Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and represent Plume at industry events and conferences.
  • Product Development Input: Provide valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams based on customer requirements and market trends, helping to inform the development of new features and solutions.
  • Technical Support: Offer prompt local and remote technical support for PoCs, lab trials, and deployment ramp-ups, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey.
  • Industry Expertise: Continuously research and stay up-to-date on the latest industry standards and emerging technologies in networking, cloud architectures, and AI.
Experience & Qualifications
  • Hands-on Technical Experience: Strong hands-on experience in the configuration and deployment of software and hardware, including Wi-Fi, networking equipment, and cloud services. A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus.
  • ISP SaaS Experience: Proven experience working with ISPs to deploy large-scale SaaS network solutions to millions of endpoints.
  • Communication & Collaboration: A track record of developing and maintaining professional, cooperative relationships with all levels of staff and customers.
  • Networking & Cloud Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CWNA, CCNA, or AWS Solutions Architect are highly preferred.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in a fast-paced environment.
Qualification Requirements
  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience working with network, security, SaaS, and/or AI industries.
  • Education: A BS/BA degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
  • Industry Knowledge: In-depth industry knowledge and a strong understanding of SDN and wireless technologies, solutions, and product offerings are preferred.
  • Communication Skills: Advanced written and oral communication skills.
  • Travel: Ability to travel >70% of the time.
Location/Language: This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in United Kingdom or Netherlands and be fluent in English.

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

We're a small global team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan, and we keep 400+ manychatters working smoothly and securely. We're organized by domains, so everyone owns an area end to end. AI is part of how we work, including our own helpdesk agent. Our docs live in GitHub, so one good answer helps many people.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

On-site and remote support

  • Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity on a Mac-first fleet managed with Jamf, with some Windows devices. Escalate complex issues to IT Administrators with full context, logs, and what you've already tried.

Access & Identity (Okta)

Knowledge and automation

  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles in Markdown. Our docs live in GitHub and go through pull requests, and our helpdesk agent answers from them, so one good article saves many tickets.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • By day 30: you know the office, the stack, and the people. You close tickets end to end and run onboardings on your own.

  • By day 60: you add or fix knowledge base articles every week, own meeting rooms and event AV in Amsterdam, and handle routine Okta changes on your own.

  • By day 90: you can cover Access & Identity when its owner is away, and you've shipped at least one improvement that removes a recurring type of ticket.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • 3+ years of IT support in a SaaS or cloud-first company, where you've covered a broad scope and know the full helpdesk lifecycle.

  • AI as part of how you work. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini every day, and describe the task clearly, check the output before you trust it. This one's a must.

  • Clear writing and fluent English: short, useful answers for users, and articles a colleague can follow without asking you.

  • You notice when a request looks wrong (say, an urgent password reset for an executive), know when to stop and escalate, and stay friendly and focused on busy days.

  • You fix the cause, not only the ticket: if something happens twice, you find out why and make it stop. You pick up new tools without waiting for training.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

jobs.title: Head of Legal @ AI Chip DeepTech Venture, Dresden / Berlin
jobs.description:
Head of Legal @ AI Chip DeepTech Venture, Dresden / Berlin

This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.


About the Venture

We build brain-inspired computing hardware designed to tackle problems that conventional computing handles badly or not at all. Our technology has its roots in leading European research and is now a commercial system, being deployed by research institutions, supercomputing centres and companies internationally.

We are a deep-tech company moving from research-led development into a much larger commercial operation. We are scaling our hardware deployments, expanding our international customer base and building the organisation and infrastructure to support the next phase of growth.

We recently closed fresh funding, are around 70 employees in size and based out of our Dresden HQ.

About the Role

This is our first legal hire.

Legal currently sits largely with the managing directors. Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction.

You will own legal end to end, from corporate and commercial through to export control, IP and product regulation. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed.

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly.

What you'll do

  • Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions.

  • Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently.

  • Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening.

  • Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements.

  • Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability.

  • Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks.

  • Manage compliance obligations connected to public funding, including grant conditions, record keeping and audit readiness.

  • Work with People & Culture on employment matters, including contracts, terminations, employee participation structures, immigration. Data protection and GDPR sit here too.

  • Oversee open-source licence compliance and software supply-chain obligations together with engineering.

  • Build the delegation layer: signing authority, approval thresholds, decision rights and clear ownership, so that routine hiring, procurement and commercial decisions do not automatically converge on the managing directors.

  • Decide what we keep in house and what goes to external counsel, then manage those firms and the associated budget.

About You

You are comfortable being the only lawyer in the building, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk. You enjoy the operational side of legal work as much as the technical side.

You are direct, commercially minded and comfortable making judgement calls. You know where your own limits are and are happy to bring in specialists when the question warrants it.

  • Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation.

  • In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening.

  • Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate.

  • You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement.

  • Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus.

  • German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin.

Why Join

You would be shaping the legal function of a company with direct access to the managing directors.

The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time.

The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. If you want to build something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role.

Senior Agronomist - Digital Agronomist Products (all genders)

The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it.

We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact.

Your mission:

You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform.

You ensure that Klim’s digital products are agronomically sound, farmer-relevant, commercially viable and delivered with high quality.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the agronomic logic behind farmer-facing recommendations and assessments - cover crop mixes, tillage transitions, rotation changes, nutrient decisions - and judge whether a given recommendation makes sense for a given soil, location and goal.

  • Translate agronomy into buildable products. Turn agronomic principles into clear product and engineering specifications.

  • Bring empathy to the farmer’s context into our products. What is going on around our product for the farmers, what data are accessible and reasonable to ask for, what value we can deliver back to famers.

  • Act as a sparring partner to product, design and modelling. Challenge assumptions, find the gaps in our thinking, and say when an approach won't land with a farmer.

  • Challenge models and outputs against field reality. You dig into the numbers, spot what doesn't add up, and explain why a result contradicts what you would expect from experience.

  • Think like the farm owner, not just the agronomist. Tell us where farmers will hesitate, what proof they'll ask for, and what makes the change worth it to them, in money and beyond.

  • Own and review agronomic datasets, literature, and assumptions used in digital products.

  • Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance.

  • Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks.

  • Support expansion into new regions by working out how farming systems differ and what that means for our recommendations.

Your profile:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in farm management, agronomic advisory, farm business consultancy, or a comparable role where you carried responsibility for real decisions on real farms.

  • You have a solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline. A strong practical track record can stand in its place.

  • You have strong, hands-on experience in open-field arable systems (cereals, oilseeds, root crops) in temperate Europe.

  • You have a deep understanding of regenerative arable farming, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems.

  • You have proven hands-on farm economics experience. You have built an investment case alongside a farmer and know which arguments actually convince, and which don't.

  • You combine regenerative conviction with practical judgment. You believe in regenerative impact and know what farmers will realistically adopt: no evangelism, no greenwashing.

  • You are interested in technology. You have used farm software, and follow what is happening in the space and believe in the potential but also see the issues.

  • You can find your way around a spreadsheet or a set of performance figures and spot where the logic breaks.

  • You have a creative spark. Given a half-formed idea, you improve it rather than only evaluate it.

Languages

  • Fluent English and fluent German. Most of our farmers are German, and you will be talking to them, reading their feedback and reviewing German farmer-facing copy. Experience of the German market is a strong advantage.

Your benefits:

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Flexible work model: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

  • Additional benefits for Germany-based employees: We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realise!

jobs.description:
Supply Chain Engineer (f/m/d)

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Achieving this ambitious goal requires more than innovative engineering — it requires a supply chain capable of turning complex technologies into reliable, manufacturable solutions.

As a Supply Chain Engineer, you'll serve as the critical technical link between our Engineering teams and external suppliers, ensuring components, materials, and systems can be sourced, manufactured, and delivered to meet our development needs. You'll own technical sourcing assessments and supplier readiness across one or two assigned technology domains, such as Laser, Targetry, Chamber, or Core Engineering.

Working closely with Engineering, Strategic Procurement, and Quality Management, you'll bring supplier capabilities and manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying technical challenges, assessing manufacturability, and addressing supply risks before they become costly delays. This is an opportunity to apply your engineering expertise in a highly collaborative, fast-moving environment where your technical judgment directly influences project readiness and our ability to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own Technical Sourcing Readiness: Lead technical feasibility and sourcing-readiness assessments across your assigned technology domain, evaluating supplier capabilities, manufacturing processes, and technical requirements from early development through sourcing readiness.

  • Connect Engineering with Suppliers: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for suppliers within your domain, partnering with Engineering and Strategic Procurement to identify, assess, and engage potential suppliers.

  • Drive Early Supplier Involvement: Bring supplier manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying manufacturability challenges and opportunities before designs are finalized.

  • Translate Engineering Requirements: Work with Engineering to clarify incomplete or ambiguous specifications, drawings, and technical requirements to ensure they are accurate and ready for sourcing.

  • Develop Supplier Readiness: Build and track technical supplier development and qualification plans in partnership with Supplier Quality, ensuring suppliers have the capabilities and readiness needed to support development milestones.

  • Improve Manufacturability and Cost: Collaborate with Engineering and suppliers to identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce complexity, optimize costs, and minimize lead times.

  • Inform Supplier Selection: Provide technical assessments, supplier capability insights, and recommendations to support Strategic Procurement's supplier evaluation and award decisions.

  • Manage Technical Supply Risks: Identify and proactively escalate supplier capacity constraints, long lead times, technical dependencies, and other risks that could impact project timelines.

  • Enable Cross-Functional Alignment: Maintain clear technical documentation, supplier readiness information, and risk assessments to support effective handovers between Engineering, Procurement, and Quality.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring experience in engineering, technical sourcing, supplier development, manufacturing engineering, or a related role within a complex technical or industrial environment.

  • You have a strong understanding of relevant manufacturing technologies, materials, processes, and supplier capabilities within your area of expertise.

  • You can evaluate technical specifications, engineering drawings, and manufacturing requirements, identifying gaps, ambiguities, and potential manufacturability challenges.

  • You have experience assessing supplier technical capabilities, manufacturing capacity, and readiness, ideally within highly engineered products, advanced manufacturing, or complex system development.

  • You understand how to balance technical requirements, manufacturability, cost, and lead-time considerations to support effective sourcing decisions.

  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and exercising independent technical judgment, knowing when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate decisions requiring Engineering, Quality, or commercial approval.

  • You are a proactive communicator who can translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, building trusted relationships with engineers, suppliers, procurement professionals, and quality teams.

  • You demonstrate strong ownership and follow-through, taking responsibility for technical sourcing readiness within your domain and ensuring risks and open issues are addressed early.

  • You enjoy working in a growing organization where you can help establish processes, strengthen supplier relationships, and contribute to building a scalable supply chain.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

jobs.description:
General Counsel at amo

amo is a Paris-based consumer social company. We want to build Europe's most ambitious consumer company. Our apps Bump and Sugar are used by millions of people all over the globe.

Location sits at the heart of one of our current products, and privacy, trust and safety are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

We're scaling fast, and this comes with legal implications. We want them handled in a way that speeds the business up.

The role:

We're hiring our first General Counsel to own amo's legal function end to end. This is a business role, not a support function: you'll work directly with the cofounders, join discussions from the start and work with every team, from Product and Distribution to People, Engineering and Finance.

You'll draft, negotiate and advise yourself on the topics that matter most. For everything else, you'll build and run a network of local counsel, with the right firm for each topic and each market, and turn their advice into clear decisions for the team.

How we think about legal:

At amo, legal starts from the product, to serve our users. We're not looking for someone who applies the rules by the book, but for someone who understands what we're building and why, and finds the legal approach that makes sense for it. You'll be judged on what you enable, not on how many memos you write.

  • Product and users first: you join discussions early and work with the team toward the same goal: making projects to life, fast and safe.

  • Pragmatic on risk: you know which rules are non-negotiable, where there is room for judgement, and how much risk is worth taking for the business. You give a recommendation, not a list of risks.

  • Built for scale: you set up the contracts, policies and processes that enable our growth.

What you'll own:

You'll cover every legal question that comes with scaling a consumer app across markets, working with the right local counsel on each topic:

  • Corporate: general corporate, group structure as we expand internationally, BSPCE plans and employee liquidity operations.

  • Employment: French labour law across the employee lifecycle, from contracts, immigration and internal rules to terminations.

  • Trademarks and IP: our global trademark portfolio: filing strategy, oppositions, watch services and disputes. Patents and content licensing as they come.

  • Compliance and data protection: GDPR, protection of minors, DSA, app store policies, and more. Regulator and law enforcement requests.

  • Commercial contracts: vendors and SaaS, partnerships, creator and influencer agreements, advertising, data processing agreements. Templates and a self-serve process so teams can move autonomously.

  • Litigation: pre-litigation and litigation across jurisdictions, with outside counsel. Clear risk assessments and options for the cofounders.

  • M&A: acquisitions and strategic transactions when the time comes, including due diligence, structuring and integration.

What success looks like:

  • Teams ship features, sign deals and expand without waiting on legal.

  • The cofounders spend far less time on legal: topics get tracked, briefed and closed without one of them driving each one, and nothing is discovered late.

  • The right local counsel is in place for each topic and market, on a budget we control.

What we're looking for:

  • Startup and scaleup experience, at our stage and beyond. 7+ years of legal experience, including a senior in-house role (General Counsel, Deputy GC or Head of Legal) at a tech company. You've lived the stage we're at international expansion, fast growth.

  • Expert in French and EU law. French legal training, with deep knowledge of French corporate and employment law, GDPR and EU digital regulation. Admission to the bar (CAPA) is a plus.

  • Global outlook. You've handled matters in several jurisdictions and know how to find, brief and challenge the right local counsel for each topic and market.

  • A true generalist. You move from a vendor contract negotiation to a trademark opposition in the same day, and know when to go deep yourself and when to bring in a specialist.

  • Product and business first. You adapt the legal approach to what the product and the business need, and give clear recommendations in plain language. You help the team move fast without taking blind risks.

  • Hands-on. You draft and negotiate yourself and don't need a team to get things done.

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • Comfortable with little structure. You set your own priorities in a noisy environment and would rather be judged on what you enabled than on how busy you were.

  • Discretion. You handle sensitive matters, including disputes, with complete confidentiality.

Nice to have:

  • Experience at a consumer app, social or gaming company.

  • Hands-on work with GDPR, content moderation (DSA).

  • M&A transactions led or closed, buy side or sell side.

  • A few years at a top-tier law firm before going in-house.

  • Exposure to a crisis, whether regulatory, press or security.

Why join:

You'll build the function from the ground up, with a seat next to the cofounders on the decisions that shape the company and a direct impact on the trajectory of a company that serves users all over the globe.

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

 

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

 

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

      We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

We're partnering with a defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.

The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As the product line expands, they're strengthening the hardware team. We're looking for a Hardware Electronics Engineer to join this team.

The Role:
You'll design electronics for UAV components, primarily flight controllers and ESCs, and own the full hardware cycle from schematic to production-ready PCB. You'll take boards through layout, manufacturing outputs, DFM with fabs and assembly houses, and into the lab for bring-up and debugging, with your designs going into products that are built at volume and used in the field.
For an engineer with a background in power electronics or motor control, this is an opportunity to work on compact, high-current boards where design decisions have direct, visible impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Design schematics for flight controllers, ESCs and related UAV electronics: component selection, power stages, MCU circuits, sensors and interfaces

  • Create multilayer PCB layouts in Altium, including high-current power routing, thermal management and signal integrity

  • Prepare manufacturing outputs: Gerbers, BOM, pick-and-place, assembly drawings

  • Support the DFM/DFA phase together with PCB fabs and assembly houses

  • Bring up and debug prototypes, and fix issues found in testing

  • Take part in peer design reviews, both giving and receiving feedback

  • Maintain design documentation and component libraries

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on hardware design experience (schematic and PCB layout)

  • Strong working knowledge of Altium Designer

  • Experience with multilayer PCBs and power electronics: DC-DC converters, MOSFET stages, current sensing

  • Experience with microcontroller-based designs (e.g. STM32) and common interfaces: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN

  • Practical understanding of DFM/DFA and work with PCB manufacturers

  • Lab skills: oscilloscope, power supply, multimeter, soldering and rework

  • Technical English sufficient to read datasheets and write documentation

Would be a plus: direct experience with drone flight controllers or ESCs (BLDC motor drives, FOC); familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4 or Betaflight hardware ecosystems; EMC/EMI-aware design for compact, high-current boards; design for harsh environments (vibration, temperature); basic Python for test automation.

Product Marketing Operations Manager | UK | Remote

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Product Marketing at Grafana Labs lives in the Product org, not the Marketing org, and we think differently about the job. As Grafana's offering shifts from dashboards to observability agents, our team closes the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. We build clear, consistent positioning, run marketing campaigns that attract new customers, and create content that helps engineering teams see why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

Rather than only executing launches and campaigns, we teach Grafana’s product managers and engineers how to think about growth and demand. We also codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone at Grafana can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

The Operations Manager keeps the Product Marketing system running and makes it better. You'll track how our work performs and report on it to the team every week, experiment with new AI workflows, and maintain the collateral and tools the team and the field depend on, so the sales team is fully supported in positioning our products. You'll work closely with the team's software engineers: you test ideas like sales deck generators or tools for competitive analysis, script prototypes, and define what good output looks like, and they turn the best ideas into production tools. You'll also coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing so we understand each other's goals and make progress on shared initiatives.

For this role you don't need to be a product marketer but you should have experience working inside a Product or Marketing organization for a software company. Since we don’t have an operations manager yet, you’ll also help to shape your own role. You should arrive with a desire to find and solve imperfectly-defined problems.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Projects and Cross-Functional Initiatives: Drive cross-functional initiatives that align with product marketing strategies across GTM, Product, and Marketing teams. Own follow-ups, task tracking, and on-time completion.
  • Cross-Team Coordination: Coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing teams so we understand each other's goals and priorities. Track shared initiatives, and coordinate enablement activities with the Enablement team.
  • Analytics and Reporting: Track the product marketing team's key metrics, such as how our content, enablement sessions, and launches perform and who uses them. Interpret and report on them to the team every week.
  • AI Experimentation and Prototyping: Try out new AI workflows and tools, using AI to write scripts and checking that they work. Decide what good output looks like and codify that judgment in evaluations, working alongside the software engineers on our team as they refine and deploy tools. Hand the most promising prototypes to engineers to make production-ready. For example, you might test a deck generator with sellers, write evals for it, and communicate about it internally.
  • Collateral Management: Maintain the team's most important collateral, including core decks, positioning content, and enablement sessions. Keep it accurate and current, share it widely, and make sure sellers know where to find it and how to use it.
  • Knowledge Base Stewardship: Help keep our shared product knowledge base complete and current. Spot missing or stale information, chase down the owners, and improve the processes that keep it up to date.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 2+ years in an operations, analytics, enablement, or technical support role within a Product or Marketing organization for a software company.
  • Strong analytical judgment: you use AI and other tools to pull data, check the results instead of taking them at face value, and turn the numbers into clear recommendations
  • Proficiency with AI agents, including building skills and automated workflows that more than one person uses
  • Good judgment about what makes AI output good, and the ability to codify that judgment in evaluations
  • Ability to quickly understand our products and describe their value: what SREs and platform engineers do, and how observability products help them
  • Ability to build dashboards and pages in Grafana, or to learn quickly
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including presenting data to a team

Bonus Points For:

  • Strong bias to action: you build, test, and ship instead of waiting for permission
  • Able to manage multiple projects and priorities at once
  • Adaptable, flexible, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills
  • Our team knows its goals and can see its progress toward them
  • More people outside the team use our AI tools and collateral
  • Collaboration with the field, Enablement, Marketing, and other partner teams runs more smoothly, leading to better working relationships and more impact across the org

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 74,342 - 89,210. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. DESCRIPTION DE POSTE :

Le stage se déroulera au sein du Pôle Qualité de Vie et Conditions de Travail à la direction des Ressources Humaines de Handicap International, avec un démarrage mi-janvier pour une durée de 6 mois. Le pôle est constitué d’une référente santé/handicap et d’une manager QVCT/prévention des risques psycho sociaux. Nous travaillons avec des acteurs externes (médecin du travail, assistante sociale, psychologues, courtiers). A noter le tutorat sera exercé par un RH et non un psychologue.

L'objectif de l'équipe QVCT est de mettre en œuvre et de coordonner la politique de protection du personnel de l'organisation afin de garantir la bonne santé psychologique et physique de tous ses employés.

CFD Workflow Automation Intern About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage | Marketing & Propositieontwikkeling
jobs.description:
Afstudeerstage | Marketing & Propositieontwikkeling

Hoe vertaal je marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar sterke proposities die zichtbaar zijn en commerciële kansen creëren? Tijdens deze hbo- of wo-afstudeerstage bij Risk Solutions, onderdeel van Centric, ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend vraagstuk waarin marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en procesoptimalisatie samenkomen.

Risk Solutions ondersteunt organisaties bij het beheersen van financiële, operationele en compliance-risico’s. Denk aan oplossingen en dienstverlening rondom kredietacceptatie, risicobeoordeling, Wwft, AML, KYC en fraudebeheersing. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over de markt, klanten, risico’s en wetgeving. De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten.

Jouw afstudeeropdracht

Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je kijkt waar het proces beter of efficiënter kan en werkt daarbij samen met collega’s uit onder andere Marketing, Sales, Business Consultancy, Compliance en Risk Management.

De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd?

Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. Daarbij verdiep je je onder andere in kredietacceptatie, financiële risico’s, AML, Wwft, KYC en fraudepreventie. Je onderzoekt welke financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken bij klanten spelen, hoe organisaties daarmee omgaan en welke waarde verschillende oplossingen daarbij bieden. Ook kijk je naar wat belangrijk is voor bijvoorbeeld een Compliance Officer, Risk Manager, kredietmanager of directielid.

Daarnaast onderzoek je de zichtbaarheid van de verschillende proposities. Je kijkt hoe kanalen en middelen zoals de website, SEO, LinkedIn, klantcases, whitepapers, nieuwsbrieven, webinars en evenementen worden ingezet en waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Ook onderzoek je welke werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht en waar AI kan ondersteunen.

Op basis van je onderzoek ontwikkel je een Marketing & Proposition Launch Framework. Hierin leg je een vaste werkwijze vast om een propositie van idee en positionering naar content, campagne, leadopvolging en evaluatie te brengen. Je maakt hiervoor praktische hulpmiddelen, zoals templates voor proposities en campagnes, afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om resultaten te meten.

Tijdens je stage test je deze werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie. Samen met de betrokken collega’s doorloop je de verschillende stappen en maak je bijvoorbeeld een propositiecanvas, contentplan, campagne-opzet of salesmateriaal. Op basis van wat je in de praktijk tegenkomt, pas je de werkwijze aan. Zo ligt er aan het einde van je stage een aanpak die het team daarna zelf kan blijven gebruiken.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je analyseert het huidige proces, van marktontwikkeling en propositie tot campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging.

  • Je onderzoekt de markt en concurrenten en verdiept je in de financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken die bij klanten spelen.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe proposities het beste in de markt kunnen worden gezet en welke content en kanalen bijdragen aan meer zichtbaarheid en vindbaarheid.

  • Je kijkt hoe AI en automatisering kunnen helpen om werkzaamheden slimmer en efficiënter uit te voeren.

  • Je test de ontwikkelde werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie en gebruikt de resultaten om deze verder te verbeteren.

Je sluit je stage af met meer dan alleen een onderzoeksrapport. Je levert een geteste en praktische werkwijze op die het team daarna kan blijven gebruiken, inclusief hulpmiddelen, duidelijke afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om de resultaten te volgen.

Dit krijg je

  • Een afstudeerstage waarin je niet alleen onderzoekt, maar ook ontwikkelt en test

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ideeën

  • Een laptop van de zaak

  • Toegang tot de Centric Academy

  • Een stagevergoeding van €550 per maand op basis van 40 uur per week

  • Leuke activiteiten en borrels

Dit breng je mee

Voor deze afstudeerstage volg je een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Commerciële Economie, Marketing, Bedrijfskunde, International Business, Finance & Control, Finance, Communicatie, Business Innovation of een vergelijkbare studie. Volg je een wo-master en zoek je een meewerkstage waarin je onderzoek met praktijkervaring kunt combineren? Ook dan ben je van harte welkom om te solliciteren.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je interesse in marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en commerciële vraagstukken

  • Ben je geïnteresseerd in financiële en compliancevraagstukken

  • Heb je enige ervaring met het uitvoeren en verwerken van onderzoek, bijvoorbeeld markt-, concurrentie- of doelgroepanalyse

  • Werk je zelfstandig, gestructureerd en resultaatgericht

  • Schakel je makkelijk tussen verschillende stakeholders en vakgebieden

  • Heb je interesse in digitale marketing, data, AI en automatisering

  • Ben je communicatief vaardig en beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • Heb je ervaring met tools voor data-analyse, CRM, online marketing of AI, zoals Excel, Power BI, Google Analytics of Copilot? Dan is dat een pre.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Wij zijn Centric, een IT-software en services bedrijf dat verweven zit in de Nederlandse Maatschappij. Vaak zie je ons logo niet op onze producten, maar ze worden gebruikt door o.a. gemeenten, grote retailers, banken en ziekenhuizen. Door bij ons te werken omring je jezelf met kansen. Kansen om impact te maken terwijl jij jezelf ontwikkelt! Geïnteresseerd? Neem vooral even contact op!

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan via de button. Heb je vragen? Dan kan je contact opnemen met onze Campus Recruiter, Nicolle, via  of +316 10 63 99 27.

jobs.title: Deployed Engineering Manager, Northern Europe & DACH
jobs.description:
Deployed Engineering Manager, Northern Europe & DACH

About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About The Role

As the Deployed Engineering Manager for Northern Europe, you will lead a team of deployed engineers from our hub in Amsterdam, working with our customers across DACH and Benelux. You'll help build and shape the team, grow the people in it and make sure our customers get the technical partnership they need to build and run great agents in production. This is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a company shaping the future of AI-powered software.

DEs work alongside our sales team to help our prospects and customers build reliable, scalable agents for their business using our suite of products: LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and LangSmith. The team focuses on pre-sales efforts, but stays on accounts to not only close new business but also to make our customers wildly successful.

Your first job is your people. You will support great deployed engineers, ramp them quickly, coach them through live customer work and build a team where they do the best work of their careers. You'll stay close enough to the technology and to our customers to be credible with both: unblocking your team on hard engagements and stepping in on the region's most important opportunities.

You will report to the Director of Deployed Engineering, EMEA and partner closely with LangChain's sales leaders covering DACH and Benelux, with shared ownership of regional outcomes.

This role is mostly people leadership, with real customer engagement and revenue accountability alongside it. As part of the EMEA deployed engineering leadership team, you'll also bring what you learn back into the playbooks, processes and standards we use globally.

What You'll Do:

  • Grow the DACH/Benelux DE team: support recruiting, interviewing and closing candidates as the team grows and raise the bar with every hire.

  • Onboard and ramp new DEs quickly, with a clear definition of what "ramped" looks like and the support to get each person there.

  • Coach your team through live customer work: join calls, review architectures and proofs of value to provide direct, specific feedback that makes people better.

  • Own performance management: set clear expectations, recognise great work and address underperformance early and fairly.

  • Run the team's operating rhythm: account coverage, capacity and load balancing, deal and engagement reviews and the regional cadence with sales.

  • Partner with sales leadership in DACH and the Benelux on account strategy, coverage and technical win plans, with shared accountability for revenue outcomes and customer success.

  • Bring regional insight to the global DE team: what's working with customers in the region, product feedback and contributions to shared playbooks.

  • Develop future leaders, growing the senior DEs who will lead the next teams in the region.


How to be successful in the role:

  • 7+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles at a dev tools, AI, or infrastructure company.

  • 2+ years managing customer-facing engineers, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

  • A track record of developing people: engineers you hired and grew who went on to bigger scope or roles.

  • Technical credibility with your team and your customers: you're not a stranger to Python, and are well-versed in software engineering, platform engineering and solutions architecture. Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agents is a strong plus.

  • Experience working with or selling to developers and engineering-led buyers and an understanding of how enterprises in the region evaluate and buy (procurement, data protection, hosting and sovereignty requirements).

  • Exceptional communication and technical storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers and coach others to do the same.

  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a consistently high bar for excellence.

  • Fluent English; German strongly preferred.

  • Must be available to work in Amsterdam, with regular travel across the region.

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
Marketing Intern

We’re looking for a Marketing Intern to join the Contentoo team and help us turn good ideas into things people actually see.

This is a social and content-first role for someone who likes writing, design, internet culture, and making things. You might be a writer with a good visual eye, a designer who understands content, or somewhere in between.

You'll work with our Content Lead and Content Marketer, and you’ll help drive social media, campaigns, thought leadership, and podcasts. You'll start with hands-on execution and gain more ownership as you grow, all while collaborating with our wider team of specialists across events, SEO, design, video, and growth.

We're a small team, which means you won't spend six months doing one tiny corner of Marketing. You'll get to see how ideas go from “we should do something about this” to an actual campaign, post, page, podcast, or piece of content in the world.

 

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine human expertise, technology, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams — so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgement.

We're based in Amsterdam and work with ambitious marketing teams across Europe and beyond.

 

What you’ll be doing

A big part of the role is helping us get more mileage out of the ideas and content we already create.

You’ll help:

  • Publish and schedule social content

  • Engage with our community and keep an eye on conversations

  • Turn podcasts, reports, customer stories and existing content into new social formats

  • Create and adapt carousels, memes, quote cards, screenshots and other social assets

  • Support our employee advocacy and thought-leadership programmes

  • Help maintain our content and social calendars

  • Upload and format content on our website

  • Keep our content library, customer proof and marketing assets organised and up to date

  • Support campaigns with research, assets, distribution and reporting

  • Research competitors, trends and interesting things happening across marketing

  • Help with podcast, thought-leadership and event research

  • Spot good content worth giving a second (or third) life

You won't necessarily arrive knowing how to do all of this. That's the point!

 

Who we’re looking for

We're less interested in finding someone who already knows every marketing acronym and more interested in someone with taste, curiosity, and initiative.

You might be a good fit if:

  • You love writing or design — ideally with an interest in both

  • You understand what makes something interesting on social

  • You're curious about marketing, brands and internet culture

  • You notice good ideas, good copy and good creative

  • You're organised and care about the small details

  • You're comfortable learning new tools and figuring things out

  • You can take a clear brief and increasingly run with it

  • You have ideas of your own and aren't afraid to suggest them

  • You can start asap and are available 24- 40 h per week, being Tuesday to Thursday at our office in Amsterdam.

Figma skills are a big bonus.

Experience with CMSs, social scheduling, SEO, AI tools, or other marketing platforms is nice to have, but none of it is essential.

Video editing skills are also welcome, but this isn't a video-first role.

 

What you’ll learn

We want this to be an internship where you leave considerably better at marketing than when you arrived.

You'll get exposure to how a small Marketing team works across:

  • Social and content strategy

  • Brand and creative

  • Campaigns

  • Thought leadership

  • SEO and AI search

  • Customer and market research

  • Events and community

  • Product Marketing

  • B2B demand generation

  • Marketing performance and experimentation

You'll start by supporting the team with production and execution, but the goal is for you to take on more progressively.

Spot a meme opportunity? Make it.

Think there's a better hook? Tell us.

Find something interesting in the research? Bring it in.

Have an idea we haven't thought of? Even better.

 

What you'll get

  • A front-row seat to modern B2B marketing and the future of content

  • The chance to learn directly from experienced marketers in branding, ABM, and demand gen

  • The opportunity to experiment with leading AI tools and platforms

  • A €600 monthly internship compensation based on a full-time (40 h) internship. If you can't/don't want to work full-time, we are open to 24- 32 h per week too!

  • Free lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens + remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team — with rooftop drinks, Mario Kart battles, boat days, and more

 

Sounds interesting?

Let's have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)
