Senior Product Manager, App o11y | UK | Remote

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap

We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Enterprise Customer Success Manager

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This role is a remote position open to candidates residing in Germany. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

Will require travel to customer sites in Germany, The Netherlands and the United Kingdom, for up to 20% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether a customer achieves their sustainability goals, or whether power gets restored quickly after an incident
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Fluency in German required

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
Seasonal Customer Love Associate - (Remote - GA based)

Who We Are:

Being naked is the #1 most sustainable option. We're #2.

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter and winning a Best Carbon Footprint award, we have big goals like being Climate Positive by 2025, Circular by 2030, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in Drapers and Sourcing Journal, and TIME wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own sustainable factory in LA. We innovate across categories like accessories, swimwear, and sleepwear, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this, this, and this.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

What You’ll Do:

Who You Are:

Extra Credit:

Compensation:

For this role, the anticipated wage for this position is $17.60 - $18.65 per hour, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.

This role may also be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a range of factors, including company performance, department goals, and individual contributions. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and are determined at the company’s discretion.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.
  • We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.
  • We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds.

Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the world we want to live in. jobs.title: Head of Marketing - Argentina / Uruguay
jobs.description:
Head of Marketing - Argentina / Uruguay

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

We're searching for an exceptional marketing leader to grow Halter in Argentina and Uruguay - one of the biggest cattle regions in the world. You’ll be building recognition for Halter’s brand that reaches every farming community, with revenue performance to match. We're making our first moves on the ground and we need a senior leader to build the marketing foundation and be part of our core team.

This role is a key driver of full-funnel revenue performance: acquisition, expansion, and retention, all through marketing. You're not running events and content on instruction or directive from HQ. You are accountable for the local marketing strategy to achieve our revenue outcomes. That means thinking like a revenue owner first, and a marketer second.

Your job is to make sure marketing shows up as a genuine lever across that whole funnel: helping win new farmers, and also feeding the stories, proof points and community that keeps existing farmers expanding and retained. You, in tight collaboration with go-to-market leadership, will build this strategy, build the team to deliver against it, and own the demand and pipeline that drives Halter's growth for years to come.

We want you to own marketing for this region. You will have full support from Halter’s global marketing team based in New Zealand HQ, with the brand and strategic frameworks you need to do your job - think of this as our DNA and standardised thinking and that lets every region move fast without reinventing the wheel. We are building the feedback loop to take your feedback and wins, and globalise them, to make Halter’s marketing brilliant in all of our key markets. But ultimately the buck stops with you in Argentina and Uruguay - acquire, expand and retain the best farms in one of the best farming regions globally.

Who we are looking for:

  • A full-funnel revenue thinker, not a channel specialist. You've owned acquisition, expansion, and retention outcomes, not just top-of-funnel demand generation. You think in pipeline and revenue contribution first, achieved through strategically driving brand awareness

  • Deeply customer-led. You're energised by time on farm with cattle farmers, and you turn that firsthand understanding into commercial decisions such as messaging, proof points, and channel choices, not just generic content ideas.

  • A builder and world-class operator. You will build and lead a high-performing, efficient team, ideally with experience scaling a marketing or growth function in a fast paced environment. You will be comfortable rolling your sleeves up and playing ‘executor’, while also knowing the right time to give space to your team to win (or loose) and learn from that experience

  • Genuinely commercial. You’re not just comfortable being measured on a revenue number - you demand it from yourself and your team. You move fast on real bets, you’re allergic to decisions not backed by data, and you thrive on seeing real results in real time.

  • First-principles by instinct. You use Halter's global frameworks because they're smart, not because you're told to, and you know exactly when the local market demands something different, and can make that case with evidence, not opinion.

  • A strong operator across both brand and demand. You’re equally comfortable in a tone-of-voice conversation and a CAC/ROI conversation, and you’re able to move between the two with ease

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You'd rather own the outcome and figure out the path than wait for a fully specified brief.

  • AI-forward as a default operating mode, not a tool you occasionally reach for. You and your team use AI to draft and iterate content, personalise outreach at a scale a human team couldn't match manually, and analyse campaign and funnel data faster than a traditional team would. You treat headcount as a last resort after you've pressure-tested what AI can already do, not the other way around.

What the role looks like:

  • Strategy & ownership: Own the marketing strategy and budget end to end, setting the vision and the plan to take Halter from early-market entry to category leadership and one of our largest revenue markets.

  • Organic growth & content. Build content that compounds: SEO-driven farmer resources, owned channels, and organic social that establishes Halter as the trusted voice in cattle, not just a paid acquisition function.

  • Events strategy. This sits at the heart of our territory manager regional model. You'll partner with sales leadership to decide which field days, expos, and farmer gatherings actually move pipeline in AU, and how they connect directly into the territory manager's patch and pipeline, not run as a separate marketing calendar.

  • Case studies & proof. Build a library of farmer stories and results that do double duty: acquisition proof points for new farmers, and expansion/retention proof points for existing ones.

  • Paid traffic. Work with the global Performance Marketing function running paid channels in-region with a sharp eye on customer acquisition costs (CAC) and pipeline contribution, not just reach or impressions.

  • Enterprise motion. Support and drive the enterprise/larger-account pipeline in AU specifically, where the buying committee, proof requirements, and sales cycle look different from owner-operator farms.

  • Accountability for the numbers: Own and report on pipeline, CAC, brand awareness and the complete revenue picture. Marketing is one of the most critical levers that sits right across the funnel, so it’s expected you will design the marketing strategy around each metric from acquisition through to net dollar retention.

  • Brand and tone of voice in-region. Use Halter's global brand as the foundation, and make the judgment calls on how it lands with Argentinian and Uruguayan farmers specifically: language, imagery, humour, what plays and what doesn't in this market.

  • Objection handling through stories, not just spec sheets. Build ROI case studies and compelling storytelling, delivered through the right channels at the right point in the funnel, that neutralise the objections AU farmers actually raise (price, proof, switching risk), not generic feature messaging.

Our Office First Approach:

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Full-Time Argentina

Our benefits:

About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations.

At Quantum Systems, you’ll work alongside experts across disciplines, take ownership from day one and help turn ambitious ideas into technology with real-world impact. We move fast, think beyond boundaries and give our teams the space to shape what comes next.

The Future is Unmanned - But the responsibility is not.

jobs.description:
(Senior) Privacy Manager - Governance & Legal (all genders)

Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As our (Senior) Privacy Manager (all genders), you will further shape and build getolo's privacy organisation enabling us to further scale and expand our European business. You will take ownership of developing our privacy framework, from governance structure, processes and controls to tools and documentation, and bring it to life across the company. You will report to our Head of Governance & Legal, who will be your sparring partner and support you in implementing the relevant structures.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1–2 days per week in our Berlin office.

Requirements

Your Mission

Strengthening our privacy organisation

  • Taking getolo's privacy organization to the next level: furthering governance model, roles and responsibilities, policies, processes and controls
  • Define clear accountabilities between business teams, privacy and control functions (3 lines of defense), and establish the corresponding reporting and escalation lines
  • Reinforce a sustainable records of processing and data inventory that will keep pace with our products and data landscape going forward
  • Furthering privacy monitoring and controls, including KPIs and regular management reporting
  • Strengthening privacy awareness across the company through training and practical guidance

 

Privacy by design & technology

  • Embed privacy by design and by default into our product and software development lifecycle
  • Work with data and engineering teams on data architecture, retention and deletion concepts
  • Drive the implementation and automation of processes and privacy tools, e.g. DSR workflows and data mapping solutions

 

Day-to-day privacy advisory

  • Act as the first point of contact for data protection issues across business projects, ensuring compliance with the GDPR, BDSG, TDDDG and related regulations
  • Conduct and guide data protection impact assessments and risk assessments with our DPO at Zurich, and drive the mitigation of identified risks
  • Prepare, review and negotiate data processing agreements, international transfer mechanisms and privacy clauses
  • Oversee the handling of data subject requests and personal data breaches, including notification processes
  • Ensure the compliant processing of special categories of personal data, in particular health data
  • Assess AI use cases from a privacy perspective and support our AI inventory and AI risk assessments
  • Continuous Exchange with our DPO and her Privacy Team at Zurich

Governance & legal support

  • Prepare, review, and coordinate commercial contracts within established templates / frameworks, involving Group Legal where required
  • Contribute to the maintenance and accuracy of legal templates, registers, and internal guidance materials
  • Monitor and give advice on legislative and regulatory developments in data protection and digital regulation

Project Management

  • Apply structured project management methodologies to deliver governance & legal initiatives efficiently
  • Scope, plan, and execute cross-functional projects, ensuring stakeholder alignment and measurable outcomes
  • Champion process optimisation and continuous improvement in operational workflows, drawing on best practices from modern legal operations and project delivery models

What you will need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data protection, ideally in-house in a regulated, fast-paced or international environment
  • Proven experience in building or substantially developing a privacy organisation, not only operating an existing one
  • The ability to translate legal requirements into processes, controls and clear responsibilities, and familiarity with common governance and control models
  • Technical affinity and an understanding of software development, data flows, cloud environments and automation
  • Ideally a legal background, such as the First and Second State Examination or a degree as Wirtschaftsjurist (LL.B./LL.M.); we also welcome candidates with a different background and a strong privacy track record
  • Fluent in German and English

Personal attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach
  • Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager
  • High integrity, sound judgement, and commercial acumen
  • Comfortable operating in a lean, high-performance environment

What would make you stand out

  • A privacy certification (e.g. CIPP/E, CIPM)
  • Experience in the insurance sector or with insurance law

Benefits

Why getolo?

🌴 Salary & Vacation

  • Attractive fixed salary
  • Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st.

🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility

  • Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us
  • Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte
  • Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days

🧘 Health

  • Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
  • Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

📚 Development

  • Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year
  • Regular (360 degree) feedback

🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset

  • We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
  • Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

🧬 Values

  • Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:
    • #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes
    • #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction
    • #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions

🙌 And much more…

Das UNITY AI Booster Team

Das UNITY AI Booster Team ist UNITYs Entwicklereinheit für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von KI-Lösungen in den Geschäftsprozessen unserer Kunden. Wir entwickeln Lösungen mit hoher Technologiebandbreite, von Machine Learning Use Cases, LLM Use Cases oder eigenen Agentenplattformen. Anders als unsere Consultants sind wir näher am Code: Wir arbeiten im Projekt mit den Consultants und unserem Procurement X Team zusammen, bauen und betreiben aber die technische Plattform dahinter.

Das erwartet dich

Infrastruktur für produktive KI-Anwendungen bauen und betreiben – von der Dev-Umgebung über CI/CD bis zum stabilen Betrieb beim Kunden und außerdem:

  • LLM- und Agentic-AI-Systeme in Betrieb bringen: Inferenz- und Model-Serving-Endpunkte, Vektordatenbanken, RAG-Pipelines, MCP-Server – skalierbar, sicher, kostenbewusst.
  • Observability und Qualität verantworten: Latenzen, Token- und Infrastrukturkosten, Agenten-Tracing, automatisierte Eval- und Regressionstests.
  • Konsequent automatisieren statt Handarbeit: Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, containerisierte, reproduzierbare Deployments.
  • Sicherheit und Compliance sicherstellen: Secrets- und Zugriffsmanagement, Guardrails, Nachvollziehbarkeit nach EU AI Act.
  • Kunden bei Architektur- und Betriebsentscheidungen beraten – als technischer Sparringspartner*, nicht als Kundenmanager*.

Was du hier lernst

  • MLOps-/LLMOps-Patterns im echten Kundenbetrieb statt im Lehrbuch.
  • Wie man KI-Systeme so baut, dass sie den EU AI Act überstehen, statt ihn nachträglich zu reparieren.
  • Den Sprung vom PoC zur produktiven, kosten- und latenzbewussten Plattform.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von Software.
  • Senior-Rolle: mehrjährige Praxis im Design und Betrieb produktiver Systeme
  • Solide DevOps-Basis: Container/Kubernetes, CI/CD, agiles Entwicklungsumfeld.
  • Cloud-Erfahrung (AWS, Azure oder GCP), Deployment als Container, API oder Serverless.
  • Praxis mit Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform, Ansible, Helm oder GitOps).
  • Python plus mindestens eine weitere Sprache (Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# oder Shell).
  • Grundverständnis von LLM-Systemen: RAG-Architekturen, Prompting, Agenten-Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI).
  • Deutsch ab C1, Englisch ab B2 – sicher im Kundenkontakt, auch mal einen Workshop leiten.
  • Studienabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, KI oder vergleichbar – oder gleichwertige Praxis als Quereinsteiger* z.B. mit einer abgeschlossenen Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker * Systemintegration.

Idealterweise bringst du zusätzlich mit:

  • MLOps-/LLMOps-Praxis inkl. Evaluation von LLM-Pipelines.
  • AI-Observability-Tools (Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, OpenTelemetry-basiert).
  • Vektordatenbanken (Elasticsearch, pgvector, Qdrant o. ä.) und MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  • Model Serving/GPU-Betrieb (vLLM, Ray, KServe, Triton), FinOps für KI-Workloads.
  • Eigene Open-Source-Projekte oder Community-Beiträge.
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichem Bereitschaftsdienst (nur tagsüber, vergütet).

Für wen das hier nichts ist:

  • Wer beim PoC aufhört und Produktionsbetrieb für das Problem von jemand anderem hält.

Warum das AI Booster Team & Über uns

  • Du siehst deine Systeme im Einsatz. Wir bauen nicht auf Zuruf für einen anonymen Backlog, sondern für Kunden, deren Prozesse wir kennen – und begleiten die Lösung in den Betrieb.

  • Remote ist bei uns möglich, nicht nur geduldet: deutschlandweit, hybrid oder vollständig remote.

Über uns

UNITY ist die Managementberatung für Innovation und digitale Transformation. Dabei setzen wir insbesondere auf Künstliche Intelligenz als Schlüsseltechnologie für Effizienz und Wachstum. jobs.title: Senior Account Executive and Partnership Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive and Partnership Manager (all genders)

At Klim, we work with farmers and businesses to make regenerative agriculture a scalable and economically viable part of the food system. As a German AgriTech company, we empower farmers in improving soil health, increasing biodiversity, and capturing carbon, while generating reliable income through our platform.

Backed by €22 million in Series A funding, we are scaling our impact internationally and partnering with clients from the food and non-food industry. Since 2020, we have worked with more than 4,000 farmers across 900,000 hectares, covering more than 5% of Germany’s agricultural land.

If you are motivated by building a more sustainable food system and contributing to measurable climate impact, Klim offers the opportunity to do so at scale.

Your mission

As part of Klim's Business Development Team within the Commercial team, you will scale our reach by building and deepening relationships with marketplaces, intermediaries, brokers, and distribution partners. You will drive revenue by developing the channels through which Klim's carbon credits reach buyers at scale and help bring carbon credits to market. This includes designing partnership structures, onboarding intermediaries, and enabling them to represent and sell Klim's offerings with confidence to buyers. This role is for someone who understands that the most durable commercial impact comes from building the right ecosystems, not just closing individual deals.

If you enjoy working in fast-moving environments, value thoughtful, consultative sales and want your work to contribute to real-world change, we are happy to hear from you.

Your responsibilities

  • Own and grow a high-value partnership pipeline, from first and ongoing conversations to contract signature and sales enablement with a variety of partners ranging from start-ups to established carbon credit marketplaces. We are looking at success measures activation of partners and sourced revenue via partnerships.

  • Research, structure, carry-out and review a partnership strategy to engage qualified and new market segments. Understand and communicate successes, risks, and mitigations transparent to management through optimized reporting and utilization of our CRM.

  • Lead structured discovery conversations to understand prospective client needs, decision criteria and internal stakeholder dynamics to present offerings that position Klim as a strategic solution provider for clients’ sustainability, ESG and climate strategies.

  • Identify, evaluate and onboard marketplace partners and distribution channels (e.g. sustainability platforms, brokers, consultancies, ESG solution providers) that can scale Klim's reach into new buyer segments.

  • Lead joint business planning conversations with partners to align on value propositions, go-to-market approaches, integration requirements and shared success metrics.

  • Design and maintain a partner enablement program, providing marketplace partners and intermediaries with the materials, training and tools needed to represent Klim's offerings effectively and compliantly.

  • Collaborate closely with finance, certification, marketing and product to ensure seamless handovers and strong client outcomes.

  • Track and monitor key sales metrics through diligent CRM maintenance, track market trends in an independent way and gather client feedback proactively to optimise individual and team sales performance.

  • Stay on top of developments in carbon markets, standards, and regulation (e.g. SBTi, Verra, CCP, CRCF) to inform conversations and sharpen positioning.

  • Represent Klim at industry events, conferences and sustainability forums to expand your network and generate new leads.

Your profile

  • Business-ready fluency in English is a must. A upper intermediate level of German (B2) is a plus.

  • At least three years of experience in a quota-carrying partnership management or sales role, with full responsibility for closing deals.

  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling partnership channels or marketplace relationships — from identifying and structuring agreements to activating and growing them over time.

  • Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder relationships with partners and intermediaries, paired with strong account management skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholder groups.

  • A proven track record of managing the full sales funnel end to end, with confidence in handling six-figure deals and maintaining strong CRM discipline, including accurate opportunity stages and clearly documented next steps.

  • General working knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies (preferably MEDDPICC) and the ability to run structured pipeline reviews, clearly articulating blockers, risks and decision paths across multiple active opportunities.

  • Experience drafting, tailoring and optimising presentations and other materials for client-facing and internal use; advanced proficiency with Google Workspace or comparable tools is required.

  • A collaborative, people-oriented mindset: you enjoy working closely with colleagues across teams and contributing to a positive, mission-driven culture.

  • Motivation to contribute to Klim’s mission of accelerating the transition to regenerative agriculture, and a belief that commercial excellence is a key lever for real-world impact.

  • A plus: experience in carbon markets and environmental policy, including voluntary carbon markets, pricing dynamics, and relevant standards and frameworks.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: We offer an attractive base salary plus uncapped commission on partner-sourced revenue. Commission is structured around partner activation and revenue growth, rewarding you for building a channel that performs at scale.

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Additional benefits for full time, Germany based employees: We offer membership in the Urban Sports Club or subsidisation of the Deutschlandticket, contribution to a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

AMI Scientist - Geometry and 3D Vision

About AMI

We are building a new breed of AI systems that (1) understand the real world, (2) have persistent memory, (3) can reason and plan, and (4) are controllable and safe.

We are a team of scientists and engineers building frontier world model-based AI. We combine the scientific rigor of a top-tier research institute with focus on engineering excellence and execution.

We are a global company, with offices in Paris, Montreal, New York, and Singapore. Come build the future of AI with us!

About this Role

AMI believes AI agents should predict and plan using an internal model of the world — their world model. We’re looking for new team members to advance the state-of-the-art in world modeling. We believe that video is a rich and abundant source of data reflecting how the world works, and that in general models need to be able to process continuous, high-dimensional data from a variety of sensors to: (a) understand context about the current state of the physical world, (b) make predictions about how the world will evolve, possibly as a result of actions taken, and (c) plan and adapt sequences of actions to complete complex tasks, possibly in dynamic, complex environments.

 

You will work with a team on world model research efforts, with a specific focus on 3D geometry of the real world, including::

  • Self-supervised learning methods to efficiently learn from video and other continuous, high-dimensional signals

  • New architectures that efficiently learn to predict world dynamics from video and other high-dimensional signals

  • Scalable algorithms for pre-processing and curating video data

  • Evaluations for benchmarking world model understanding, prediction, and planning

  • Efficient algorithms for model-based planning and reasoning

 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field

  • Proficiency in Python

  • Ability to design, run, and analyze experiments independently

  • Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, large-scale training, and accelerator-based (GPU or TPU) compute environments

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: 3D/4D reconstruction, SLAM or SfM, depth and pose estimation, point tracking.

  • Hands-on proficiency with a rendering or simulation engine (Blender, Isaac Sim, etc.), including scripted scene generation and batch rendering pipelines.

  • Demonstrated record of contributing to advanced research projects via publications and/or major model releases

  • Experience developing evaluation frameworks for world models

  • Experience releasing and maintaining open-source projects

  • Proficiency in a deep learning framework (PyTorch or JAX)

jobs.title: HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)

Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider HR: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

Verder breng je mee:

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

jobs.title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integration Software Engineer

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Integration Software Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions used in real-world sensing and data processing systems. 

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments. 

As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements.

This role requires a hands-on professional with a proactive mindset, a structured approach to software testing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex technical systems and translate requirements into effective test strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

jobs.title: AI Builder
jobs.description:
AI Builder

The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job.

The team

You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia.

Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it.

Who you are

You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you:

Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.

You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch.

Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client.

You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it.

Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week.

If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. jobs.title: Customer Support Mitarbeiter (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Customer Support Mitarbeiter (m/w/d)

Du hilfst unseren Kund:innen weiter, schriftlich und am Telefon

Bei eRecht24 melden sich jeden Tag Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops und Agenturen: mit Fragen zu ihrem Zugang, zu Rechnungen, Tarifen und unseren Tools. Sie brauchen jemanden, der ihr Anliegen versteht, verständlich antwortet und sich um die Klärung kümmert.

Wir suchen eine Person, die unseren Customer Support in Vollzeit verstärkt und gern im direkten Kundenkontakt arbeitet. Aktuell bearbeitest du vor allem schriftliche Anfragen. Telefonische Beratung findet bereits in kleinem Umfang statt und wird Schritt für Schritt ausgebaut, eingehend und ausgehend.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 unterstützt Unternehmen bei der rechtlichen Absicherung ihrer Websites und Online-Shops. Dazu gehören der Impressum Generator, der Datenschutz Generator, der Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und mit zusätzlichen Funktionen in eRecht24 PREMIUM.

Unser Unternehmen ist in den vergangenen Jahren stark gewachsen. Jetzt professionalisieren wir unsere Abläufe und bauen unser Support-Team weiter auf. Ein modernes Ticketsystem und eine Telefonanlage sind vorhanden. Gemeinsam mit der Teamleitung und deinen Kolleg sorgst du dafür, dass Kund:innen verlässlich Unterstützung erhalten.

Deine Aufgaben

Kundenanfragen bearbeiten und Lösungen finden

  • Du beantwortest schriftliche Anfragen zu Kundenkonten, Rechnungen, Tarifen und der Nutzung unserer Plattform.

  • Du klärst Anliegen selbstständig, hältst den Bearbeitungsstand nachvollziehbar fest und verfolgst offene Fragen bis zur Klärung.

  • Bei technischen oder rechtlich relevanten Fragen bindest du die zuständigen Fachleute ein. Dafür nutzen wir regelmäßige Sprechstunden mit IT und Partnerkanzlei.

Telefonisch beraten und Kund:innen begleiten

  • Du übernimmst telefonische Anfragen und hilfst Kund:innen bei der Nutzung unserer Produkte und der Auswahl passender Tarife.

  • Mit dem Ausbau unserer Telefonberatung kommen ausgehende Gespräche hinzu, etwa zur Klärung offener Anliegen, zur Kundenbindung und zur Rückgewinnung.

  • Du erkennst, wann ein anderer Tarif besser zum Bedarf passt, und erklärst die Möglichkeiten verständlich.

Wissen festhalten und im Team zusammenarbeiten

  • Du dokumentierst wiederkehrende Fragen und bestätigte Lösungen und hältst Antwortvorlagen und Wissensbasis aktuell.

  • Du gibst Rückmeldung, wenn Anleitungen fehlen, Abläufe stocken oder dieselben Probleme wiederholt auftreten.

  • Du stimmst dich mit deiner Teamleitung und deinen Kolleg:innen ab und sorgst für nachvollziehbare Übergaben.

Deine ersten Monate

Zu Beginn: Du lernst unsere Produkte, Tarife und typischen Kundenanliegen kennen. Du arbeitest dich in unsere Systeme ein und übernimmst schrittweise eigene Anfragen.

Nach der Einarbeitung: Du bearbeitest die üblichen Anliegen selbstständig, übernimmst telefonische Kontakte und klärst komplexere Fälle mit den zuständigen Fachleuten.

Mit dem weiteren Ausbau: Telefonische Beratung, Kundenbindung und ausgehende Gespräche werden zu einem größeren Teil deiner Arbeit.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Erfahrung im Customer Support, Kundenservice oder in der Kundenberatung, idealerweise bei einem digitalen Produkt oder Abo-Anbieter.

  • Du formulierst klare, freundliche Antworten und kannst auch kompliziertere Abläufe verständlich erklären.

  • Du telefonierst gern, hörst aufmerksam zu und bleibst auch bei unzufriedenen Kund:innen ruhig und verbindlich.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, setzt Prioritäten und behältst offene Anliegen im Blick.

  • Du findest dich sicher in digitalen Anwendungen zurecht und lernst neue Systeme und Produkte zügig kennen.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch.

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Samstagseinsätzen nach abgestimmtem Dienstplan.

Ein Plus sind Erfahrungen mit Ticketsystemen, Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie, Kundenbindung oder Tarifberatung. Auch Kenntnisse rund um Websites, Online-Shops und Datenschutz helfen dir beim Einstieg.

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt, deine Verlässlichkeit und die Bereitschaft, dich in unsere Produkte einzuarbeiten.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Fachliche Unterstützung: Bei technischen und rechtlich relevanten Fragen stehen dir IT und Partnerkanzlei zur Seite.

  • Ein Team im Aufbau: Du steigst in einen Bereich ein, dessen Abläufe und Zusammenarbeit wir gerade weiterentwickeln. Deine Erfahrungen aus dem Kundenkontakt fließen dabei ein.

  • Mehr als schriftlicher Support: Mit dem Ausbau der Telefonie kommen deine Fähigkeiten in Beratung und Kundenbindung zum Tragen.

  • Direkter Austausch: Du arbeitest eng mit der Support-Teamleitung und deinen Kolleg:innen zusammen und gibst Kundenfeedback an die zuständigen Teams weiter.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit.

  • Arbeitsort Berlin mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit an telefoniefreien Tagen.

  • Einsatz im Rahmen unserer Serviceabdeckung von Montag bis Samstag.

  • Samstagseinsätze werden mit der Support-Teamleitung abgestimmt.

  • Telefoniedienste finden vor Ort statt.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: ein kurzes Kennenlernen, ein Fachgespräch und anschließend ein Einblick ins Team mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus unserem Support-Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in deiner Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welche Kundenanfragen bearbeitest du heute oder hast du zuletzt bearbeitet, schriftlich und telefonisch?

  2. Beschreibe ein schwieriges Kundenanliegen: Wie bist du vorgegangen und wie hast du es gelöst?

  3. Welche Erfahrungen hast du mit telefonischer Beratung oder ausgehenden Kundengesprächen?

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Carbon and Environmental Models (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Technical Product Manager - Carbon and Environmental Models (all genders)

The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and we turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it.

We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact.

Your mission:

  • Lead a cross functional team of Soil Scientists and Software Engineers to develop and implement SOC models as the foundation of Klim’s platform

  • Own and drive the product roadmap for carbon, biodiversity, and broader soil science and agronomic models

  • Expand Klim’s modelling capabilities beyond carbon into crop and agronomic insights, and over time into economic models such as farm level P&L

  • Contribute to the commercial scalability of Klim’s solutions and support large scale decarbonisation of agricultural supply chains


Your responsibilities:

1. Product Definition and Delivery

  • Translate scientific models into clear product requirements and features

  • Align modelling work with product and company goals

  • Drive execution from concept to production

  • Develop a strong understanding of underlying models to effectively guide product decisions and challenge assumptions

2. Model Development, Carbon and Beyond

  • Improve accuracy and scalability of carbon models as the core system

  • Expand models to include agronomic metrics, new practices, and new geographies

  • Identify and prioritise additional soil science or environmental metrics

3. Compliance and Scientific Integrity

  • Ensure alignment with key standards such as VERRA VM0042, GHG Protocol, SustainCERT, SAI RTF and ISOMETRIC

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders to maintain compliance and scientific credibility

4. Team Leadership and Execution

  • Lead and prioritise the work of a cross functional team of scientists and engineers

  • Ensure effective collaboration between scientific development and product implementation

  • Create clarity on priorities and trade offs

5. Cross Functional Alignment

  • Partner with MRV to ensure models meet regulatory requirements

  • Collaborate with Farmer Sales to ensure consistency with field data

  • Align with other product teams to integrate models into the platform

  • Incorporate client and market insights into product decisions to maximise commercial impact

Your profile:

Product and Execution Skills

  • 3 to 6 years of product management experience, ideally in data/scientific heavy or technical products

  • Proven track record of shipping products end to end

  • Experience running development cycles and sprints

  • Strong prioritization and problem solving

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast changing environment with evolving requirements and constraints

Strategic and Commercial Thinking

  • Ability to shape short to long term product strategy

  • Prioritise features based on impact, feasibility, and regulatory constraints

  • Adapt to evolving regulations and markets

Stakeholder Management

  • Translate complex technical topics for non technical audiences

  • Align multiple stakeholders across functions

  • Strong communication skills

Technical Understanding

  • Strong ability to understand complex models at a high level, including their assumptions, limitations, and implications for product decisions

  • Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as physics, engineering, environmental science, mathematics, or similar is a strong plus

  • High attention to detail and rigor when working with data, models, and assumptions

  • Able to quickly learn and reason about new technical domains

Languages

  • English required

  • German is a plus but not a requirement

Your benefits:

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Flexible work model: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

  • Additional benefits for full time, permanent employees: We offer membership in the Urban Sports Club or subsidisation of the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realise!
