jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Motorway's Product & Engineering team. Motorway is a UK online car-selling platform connecting private sellers with ~7,500 verified dealers through online auctions. You will own a problem area end to end, in either the seller or the dealer side of the marketplace, and be accountable for the outcomes you deliver.

Building is cheaper than it has ever been. The hard part now is choosing the right thing to build. We want PMs with exceptional product sense who find the problems worth solving, back that judgement with evidence, and use the latest technology to solve them in ways that weren't possible a year ago.

What you will do

Find the problems that matter

  • Identify the highest-impact problem areas by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative research, and explain clearly why they matter more than the alternatives

  • See through the hundreds of good ideas to the few that will move the business and create real value for sellers and dealers

  • Own outcome-based goals and metrics, not feature lists

Build with AI, in your work and in our product

  • Use AI to make yourself and your team faster: automate routine PM tasks, analyse data and research quickly, and prototype or vibe code solutions to get customer feedback in days, not weeks

  • Ask how each product could be built differently given what AI makes possible, and bring those ideas to your squad

  • Make your team 2x more effective, not 2x busier

Deliver with rigour

  • Lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and data specialists from discovery through launch and measurement

  • Run experiments that produce learning even when they fail, and act on what you learn

  • Make clear trade-offs between customer needs, technical constraints and business priorities

Bring people with you

  • Communicate the what, the why and the how clearly, through crisp, data-led documents and conversations

  • Work with the people closest to you (engineering, design, data) and with execs and other business units such as Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Marketing

  • Influence without authority and build alignment on difficult decisions

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a product manager, with a track record of shipping products that moved meaningful business metrics, not just delivering features

  • Strong product sense. You can show how you found and prioritised the right problem, and what you chose not to do

  • Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative evidence: you run user research and also query data, design experiments and interpret results yourself

  • Data-oriented. You use data to understand problems, set goals and measure impact, and can debate approaches with data scientists and analysts

  • AI-forward. You use AI tools regularly in your own work and have hands-on experience prototyping or building with them. You have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't

  • A clear, confident communicator who can work with engineers and analysts day to day and with senior leaders across the business

  • Ability to move between detail and strategy without losing coherence

  • Self-starter with strong ownership, a curious mindset, and the ability to build domain knowledge quickly

Every Genesis robot runs on a custom jetson thor compute board and every piece of software we write: control, perception, learned policies, depends on the Linux image underneath it. We are looking for a senior engineer to own that image end to end: build it, ship it to the robot, keep it updatable, and make it easy for the rest of the team to compile and deploy on top of it.

This is an in-house ownership role. You will be the reference for embedded Linux at Genesis, working closely with our embedded, robotics and application-software engineers in Paris and with our hardware partners. The job is to provide a reliable, well maintained and up to date os image, customized to our needs.

What You'll Do

  • Build, own and maintain the production Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution for our robot's custom board: BSP, kernel, device tree, rootfs, toolchain and custom layers.

  • Bring up new hardware on NVIDIA Jetson-class platforms, integrating drivers and peripherals. Including hands-on debugging of components such as Wi-Fi, cameras, audio devices and buses on the physical robot.

  • Own the full image lifecycle: reproducible builds, versioned releases, secure and robust over-the-air (OTA) updates, and long-term maintenance as hardware and software evolve.

  • Deliver a development kit and workflow (SDK, cross-compilation, deployment tooling) so engineers can build and ship their software onto the robot quickly.

  • Integrate GPU and AI-accelerator inference stacks so that our models run efficiently on the robot.

  • Speed up the team's build and CI pipeline for image generation and validation. Builds are long, so caching and automation matter, as well as removing unnecessary dependencies.

  • Document the system and make it approachable, so the image is never again a black box that only one person (or contractor) understands.

Your First Three Months

  • Build a custom Yocto image for the robot's custom boards.

  • Flash, boot and validate it on real hardware, working through driver and integration issues on-site.

  • Set up the cross compilation workflow, caching, CI automations to streamline the robotics team work

What You'll Bring

  • Passion for your craft and demonstrated excellence in embedded Linux engineering.

  • 5+ years of hands-on embedded Linux experience, including shipping at least one Yocto-based image to production not only a prototype.

  • Proven ownership of an image through its lifecycle: maintenance, release management and remote/OTA updates.

  • Deep experience with Yocto internals: layers, recipes, BitBake, machine and distro configuration, SDK generation.

  • Strong board bring-up and low-level debugging skills: kernel configuration, device trees, drivers, boot chain.

  • The ability to explain how your work fits into the wider build, development and deployment system.

Bonus

  • Experience integrating GPU / AI-accelerator inference (CUDA, TensorRT or similar) on embedded targets.

  • Background in robotics, drones, connected devices or other products with custom hardware.

  • Experience working with chip vendors or ODMs.

  • Familiarity with secure boot, real-time kernel tuning (PREEMPT_RT) or OTA frameworks such as Mender, RAUC or SWUpdate.

  • French and English. Mandarin is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Unblock teammates' requests quickly and pragmatically, and know when "good enough to ship" is the right answer.

  • Stay patient and methodical when a single build takes two hours and a bug only shows up on hardware.

  • Like startup flexibility: changing priorities, short feedback loops and work that ranges from kernel to tooling.

jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description:
GPU Engineer

About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description:
Senior Quality Assurance Officer

About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. 

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. 

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment.

  • Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work.

  • A systematic, process-oriented way of working.

  • The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems.

  • A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements.

  • The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices.

Nice to have:

  • Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working.

  • Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required.

  • Experience with MDSAP

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including pension plan 

  • 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position 

  • Hybrid work model 

  • Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht 

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

  • Training budget 

  • Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics 

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited?

jobs.title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)
jobs.description:
Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)

About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

jobs.title: Co-Founder & COO (m/w/d) gesucht für Corporate Philanthropy Plattform | Düsseldorf/Remote
jobs.description:
Co-Founder & COO (m/w/d) gesucht für Corporate Philanthropy Plattform | Düsseldorf/Remote

Über Bonoboo


Bei Bonoboo bauen wir die Plattform für Corporate Philanthropy. Mit KI-gestütztem Matchmaking verbinden wir Unternehmen gezielt mit passenden gemeinnützigen Organisationen. Das Ziel: messbare Wirkung, effizientere Spendenprozesse und datenbasiertes gesellschaftliches Engagement. Wir sind ein wachsendes, internationales Team mit Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf und wollen die Spendenbranche nachhaltig verändern.

Wo wir stehen
Unser Produkt ist validiert, und erste Unternehmen setzen Bonoboo bereits zahlend ein. Wir sind mitten in der Pre-Seed-Phase, mehrere Business Angels sind an Bord, und das Kapital für die nächsten Schritte ist gesichert. Jetzt geht es darum, aus einem funktionierenden Produkt ein skalierendes Unternehmen zu machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Wer wir sind

  • Julia, CEO & Founder: bringt Expertise in Sales und Finance mit und verantwortet Vertrieb, Finanzen und Fundraising.

  • Max, CTO & Co-Founder: hat Erfahrung als KI-Entwickler und verantwortet Produkt und Tech.

Was uns noch fehlt, ist die Person, die den Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo nicht nur mitdenkt, sondern operativ führt und nach außen trägt.

Deine Aufgaben als Co-Founder & COO

Du verantwortest den gesamten Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres Start-ups maßgeblich mit.

Strategie & Impact
Du denkst mit uns die großen Fragen: Wie skaliert Corporate Philanthropy? Wo hebeln wir Wirkung am stärksten? Du bringst strategische Klarheit in ein Feld, das oft unscharf bleibt.

Operative Leitung Impact
Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für alles, was mit Impact zu tun hat, von Prozessen bis zur Reporting-Logik. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Vision gelebte Praxis wird.

NGO-Partnernetzwerk & Success Management
Du baust unser Netzwerk an NGO-Partner:innen auf und pflegst es. Du verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und sorgst dafür, dass Partnerschaften auf der Plattform für beide Seiten wirklich funktionieren.

Bühne & Pitches
Du bist eines der Gesichter von Bonoboo: auf Startup-Bühnen, bei Pitches und im Gespräch mit Kund:innen, Partner:innen und Investor:innen. Du erzählst unsere Story mit Substanz, Überzeugung und Begeisterung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in Strategy, Business Development oder Operations, idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu CSR, HR oder dem NGO-Sektor

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du treibst Dinge eigenständig voran und baust Prozesse und Strukturen auf, statt nur darüber zu reden.

  • Kommunikationstalent: Du begeisterst andere für Impact-Themen, auf der Bühne genauso überzeugend wie im 1:1 mit unseren NGO-Partner:innen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung für das Ganze übernehmen und Bonoboo gemeinsam mit uns aufbauen und skalieren.

  • Leidenschaft für Impact: Du glaubst daran, dass Unternehmen und NGOs gemeinsam mehr bewegen können, wenn die Partnerschaft wirklich passt.

Deine ersten Monate

In den ersten drei bis sechs Monaten baust du unser NGO-Partnernetzwerk systematisch aus. Du setzt die Prozesse für Matching und Impact Reporting auf und stehst bei den ersten Pitches mit auf der Bühne. Gemeinsam mit Julia und Max legst du fest, wie Bonoboo im nächsten Jahr wachsen soll.

Das bieten wir

  1. Teil des Gründungsteams: Anteile, Mitsprache und Einfluss auf die Richtung des Unternehmens. Bonoboo wird auch dein Unternehmen.

  2. Flexibles Arbeiten: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitstag selbst und arbeitest dort, wo du am produktivsten bist. Für die wichtigen Momente treffen wir uns regelmäßig in Düsseldorf.

  3. Raum zum Wachsen: Austausch mit unseren Business Angels und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk für deine persönliche und unternehmerische Entwicklung.

  4. Ein modernes Software-Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Impact

  5. Ein Team, das schnell entscheidet und mit Leidenschaft arbeitet

  6. Die Chance, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten und Corporate Philanthropy neu zu denken

Vergütung

3.000–6.000 € brutto im Monat, plus Unternehmensanteile. Die konkrete Beteiligung legen wir gemeinsam im Kennenlernprozess fest.

So lernen wir uns kennen

  1. Erstes Gespräch: lockeres Kennenlernen. Wer bist du, wer sind wir, passt das grundsätzlich?

  2. Zweites Gespräch: Wir steigen tiefer ein, in Impact, Strategie und deine fachliche Perspektive auf Bonoboo.

  3. Drittes Treffen, gerne persönlich in Düsseldorf: Wir lernen uns auf persönlicher Ebene kennen und sprechen über Anteile und die Rahmenbedingungen.

Klingt nach dir? Dann melde dich bei uns. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Consultant SAP S/4HANA Transformation
jobs.description:
Consultant SAP S/4HANA Transformation

Für viele Unternehmen ist S/4HANA ein Pflicht-Upgrade. Bei UNITY ist es deine Mission, daraus eine echte unternehmerische Entscheidung für unsere Kunden zu machen: Wohin soll sich die Prozess- und Systemlandschaft bewegen? Was kostet welcher Weg und wer setzt ihn um? Und wie bleibt das Programm steuerbar? Du sitzt auf der Seite des Kunden. Du gestaltest End-to-End-Prozesse, Zielarchitektur und Programmsteuerung. Die technische Implementierung übernimmt unser Partnernetzwerk.

Unser Anspruch als Business Integrator: Wir schützen das, was unsere Kunden vom Wettbewerb unterscheidet (wir nennen das „Prozess-DNA“) und helfen ihnen zu verstehen, was sich nicht unterscheiden sollte.

Das erwartet dich

  • Transformationspfad entwickeln: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Team an Vorprojekten zur Auswahl von ERP-Systemen samt Definition von Zielbild, Leitplanken, Zielarchitektur, Deploymentvariante (RISE vs. GROW, Cloud vs. On-Premise) und Transformationspfad (Greenfield, Brownfield, Lift-&-Shift) inklusive Business Case.

  • Zielarchitektur mitgestalten: Du arbeitest an Clean-Core-Konzepten, an SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP) – auf Basis von SAP BTP als Entkopplungsplattform und an Datenstrategien, etwa für Datasphere oder SAP Analytics Cloud.

  • Programme transparent begleiten: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung einer tragfähigen Roadmap und sorgst im PMO mit Tools wie SAP Signavio, LeanIX und SAP Cloud ALM für Klarheit über Fortschritt, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.

  • Den richtigen Partner an Bord holen: Du gestaltest Transformationsausschreibungen – im Mittelstand und Konzern ebenso wie vergaberechtskonform bei öffentlichen Auftraggebern und Kliniken.

  • KI dort einsetzen, wo sie wirkt: Du identifizierst Use Cases for SAP Business AI und Joule, etwa in der Custom-Code-Analyse, bei der Datenqualität oder mit unseren KI-Agents in Einkauf, Supply Chain und Order-to-Cash.

  • Branchenwissen aufbauen: Du arbeitest in Industrie und Handel, im Krankenhaus (IS-H-Ablösung, KIS-Szenarien) oder in der Energiewirtschaft (IS-U).

Künstliche Intelligenz @UNITY

Bei UNITY arbeitest du mit KI, die du selbst mitgestalten kannst: die eigenentwickelte UNITY X-Plattform gibt dir Zugriff auf verschiedene Claude-, ChatGPT & Gemini Modelle. Copilot und Claude-Modelle sind direkt in Teams und den Microsoft-Anwendungen verfügbar. In Copilot Studio kannst du außerdem eigene Agenten bauen, wenn du willst. UNITY Coding Communities, Hackathons, AI Labs und das AI Trainings Camp geben dir Raum, eigene Lösungen für intern und für Kunden zu bauen.

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves Junior

  • Erste Praxiserfahrung entweder in einer Management- oder IT-Beratung oder auf Kundenseite in der Industrie

  • Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse in mindestens einem Bereich, zum Beispiel Finance, Logistik, Einkauf, Produktion oder Vertrieb, und Freude daran, diese zu analysieren und zu optimieren

  • Grundkenntnisse der SAP-Vorgehensmodelle, etwa SAP Activate, und der Migrationsszenarien

  • Die Fähigkeit, KI wirksam und sicher anzuwenden.

  • Prägnante Kommunikation und Präsentation auf Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mindestens B2)

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Produktionstechnik oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss mit technischem oder betriebswirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt

Idealerweise

  • Erste Erfahrungen aus SAP-S/4HANA-Projekten

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit SAP BTP, Signavio oder LeanIX

  • Branchenerfahrung in Industrie, Healthcare oder Energie

  • (Senior Level): Entwicklung Architektur-Roadmaps rund um Clean Core und BTP.

  • (Senior Level): Übernahme von Teilprojektleitungen oder Streamleadfunktion.

Senior Level: Das bringst du zusätzlich mit

  • Du hast bereits mindestens eine S/4HANA-Transformation über mehrere Phasen begleitet.

  • Du bist an der Steuerung von Implementierungspartnern beteiligt gewesen und hast Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Management deiner Kunden mitgetroffen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Sammlung und Darstellung von Use Cases und/oder Change-Requests im Kontext von SAP S/4HANA Transformations-Programmen.

  • Juniors coachst du im Projekt, und du bringst eigene Ideen in unser SAP-Leistungsangebot ein.

Ehrlich gesagt: Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du vor allem selbst customizen oder in ABAP entwickeln willst. Die Implementierung liegt bei unseren Partnern, deine Stärke liegt im Steuern, Gestalten und Entscheiden. Sie passt auch nicht, wenn du lieber ein Modul tief betreust, als den Blick über Prozesse, Daten und Organisation hinweg zu weiten. Wenn dich dagegen die Frage reizt, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt messbarer Business-Nutzen wird, dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Deine Chancen und Möglichkeiten

  • Projekte mit Substanz: Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Strategie bis zum Go-Live, in Industrie, Healthcare und Energie, und siehst, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt Business-Nutzen wird.

  • Fachlicher Austausch auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest mit den Köpfen hinter unserem SAP-Angebot, darunter unsere Heads of SAP Architecture & Innovation und SAP Transformation Excellence.

  • Partnernetzwerk statt Einzelkämpfertum: Du steuerst gemeinsam mit Implementierungspartnern, statt alles selbst zu bauen, und lernst dabei die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette einer Transformation kennen.

  • SAP-Innovation aus erster Hand: Mit unserem zentralen KI-Team, AI Labs und Hackathons entwickelst du Business-AI-Use-Cases für den SAP-Kontext mit.

  • Entwicklung vom Junior zum Senior: Deine SAP-Laufbahn ist bei uns kein Zufall, sondern ein Pfad bis zur Projektleitung und Architekturverantwortung. UNITY unterstützt diese Entwicklung mit konkreten Zertifizierungen, die zu deinem Entwicklungsziel passen, sowie einem breiten Portfolio an Fach- und Persönlichkeitsentwicklungsschulungen.

  • KI, die wir selbst bauen: Zentrales KI-Team, AI Labs, Hackathons und unsere eigene UNITY X-Plattform – du entwickelst Business-AI-Use-Cases mit, statt sie nur zu präsentieren.

  • CAD-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit AutoCAD Plant 3D, AutoCAD P&ID und Autodesk Inventor

jobs.title: Content Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Content Marketing Lead

Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

About the Role

As Content Lead at Dex, you'll write and publish everything that carries our name.

You'll own Dex's channels: the website, social, email, our events programme and blog. You'll take a content strategy that already exists and turn it into a steady, high-quality output.

This is a job for someone who writes fast and well, and who thinks past the draft. The copy is half of it. The other half is knowing where a piece needs to land, what it needs to look like to get found, and what it should do to the reader once it does.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, Design and Product.

You'll have real autonomy and very little bureaucracy.

What You'll Do

  • Own the channels. The publishing calendar across site, social, email and the blog is yours. You decide what runs, when, and in what order.

  • Write across every format. LinkedIn and X posts, campaign and event emails, landing pages, product and lifecycle copy, event pages and follow-ups, articles and explainers. A 90-word page and a 1,500-word argument in the same afternoon, both sounding like us.

  • Think in distribution, not just drafts. Every piece gets planned around where it will be read: why a piece lands on Hacker News and dies on LinkedIn, which newsletters and communities our audience already trusts.

  • Write for search and AI answers. We have a GEO and SEO spec built with our search partner: answer-first structure, extractable formatting, clean internal linking, author entity pages. You'll write to it and help us improve it.

  • Carry the events programme. Copy and collateral for our event series, before, during and after, and the follow-up sequences that turn attendance into something.

  • Work the numbers. Track performance and report back on the metrics that matter across our owned blog and organic social media channels.

  • Use AI properly. Research, outlining, structuring, first passes, repurposing, quality checks. We'll give you all the Claude tokens you can use. We will not ship anything that sounds like AI wrote it, and we'll ask you how you draw that line.

  • Guard the voice. You'll be the most frequent user of our tone of voice and audience research, and the person most responsible for whether it holds up in public.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing in-house or at an agency, ideally for a technical or developer audience, ideally in a start-up where you had to build the process as well as the output

  • Genuine range across formats and lengths, evidenced by a portfolio of published work

  • A real view on distribution: where our audience discovers, consumes and shares things, and what a piece needs to look like to survive that journey

  • Working knowledge of SEO and how AI search surfaces content, enough to write to a spec and challenge it

  • Fluent with AI tools across research, outlining and iteration, with judgement about where the machine stops and you start

  • Commercial literacy. You can connect a piece of content to an outcome and look beyond vanity metrics

  • Editorial judgement under your own steam. You can take a rough steer and come back with something better than the brief

  • A proactive communicator who works well without supervision and asks for what they need

Nice to Have

  • Any technical background, formal or self-taught

  • You've run a newsletter, blog or publication of your own

  • Experience marketing to engineers, developers or another audience that punishes fluff

  • Experience with content for events and communities

  • Basic design or motion skills, enough to get a social asset out without waiting

What this role isn't

Not a strategy job. The strategy exists and you're here to execute it, though you'll influence it constantly and we expect you to argue with it.

Not a pure writing job. Publishing, sequencing, formatting, distribution and measurement are all yours.

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

Operations in banking like in every other firm is established to carry out all the day-to-day transactions of the business. Role Description

The Customer Service Advisor will be responsible for 1st line customer service support for the Bank’s Retail and SME customers via Chat (Online) and Telephony, together with Back Office activities to support the smooth running of the function.

They will be the focal point for customers – delivering exceptional service whilst living our values and speaking a language our customers will understand and understanding the business and banking challenges our customers face.

Principal Accountabilities

• To field inbound communications from customers – either over voice, chat or social media – to action their requests, resolve their issues and manage complaints through to resolution.

• You’ll be responsible for case management, and this may include outbound customer communications, payments and letter writing.

• Some of the key exceptions you’ll be dealing with will include KYC, complaints, vulnerable customers, deceased/power of attorney cases and SME customers who might have complex needs.

• To proactively identify areas for process improvement and to seek new and innovative ways to better serve the customer.

• To live and breathe the Bank’s values, representing the Bank to customers and speaking to customers in a way that resonates.

• To support other teams as appropriate, where customer communication or engagement is required.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Strong customer service experience, having worked in customer facing and or telephone service roles.

  • Experience using core banking systems and familiar with the use and application of social media as a form of interaction.

  • Experience in dealing with complex complaints and in taking ownership of customer concerns through to resolution.

  • Experience of core processes (e.g. account opening, servicing and closing, payments processing, complaint handling, KYC case referrals, general enquiry management)

  • Experience in working with workflow / task management tools

  • Knowledge of financial services rules and guidelines

  • Excellent oral and written skills as they will be constantly communicating with customers

  • Quickly react and adapt to stressful and difficult situations

  • Enthusiastic and articulate, whilst being motivated by a need to help people

  • A problem solver and can create positive customer outcomes in diverse situations

  • Conform to our ethical standards and conduct

  • Perform administrative tasks related to the customer interaction

  • Deliver outstanding customer service as measured through customer satisfaction KPIs

  • Manage and monitor service providers for customer quality

  • Drive customer service innovation and continuous improvement of process to deliver better customer outcomes

  • Act as an ambassador/advocate for Customer within the Bank

  • Adhere to quality control requirements and ensure compliance with policy

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

Don’t tick every box?

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Data Infrastructure

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

  • Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

  • Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

  • Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

  • Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

  • You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

  • Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

  • Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

  • Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

  • Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

  • Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

  • Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

Staff Backend Engineer

WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it.

As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Engineering team:

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

  • Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance.

  • Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

  • Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

  • Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

  • Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in Python backend development and a broad view of backend architecture beyond one language. You can understand existing systems, even when the technology is new to you.

  • A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities.

  • Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features.

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems and data flows: API contracts, async processing, data consistency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Knowledge of how backend applications are deployed and run in production: configuration, networking, and external dependencies.

  • Knowledge of application security basics: authentication, authorization, data isolation, and access management.

  • Comfort in a fast-changing environment. Things can shift quickly here, and the team relies on everyone's proactivity and ownership.

  • Strong English for technical and product discussions and for documentation.

It would be great if you have:

  • Hands-on PHP experience, on top of understanding how our Python and PHP systems work together.

  • Experience with ETL/DWH pipelines and analytics systems.

  • Experience with environment configuration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience improving AI-assisted software development practices.

Our tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery. Our services integrate with Manychat's PHP-based platform. Everything runs on AWS and Kubernetes, with Terraform/Terragrunt for infrastructure. You don't need hands-on experience with every tool. Technical depth and the ability to reason about complex systems matter most.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family.

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

Possessing strong proficiency with Kubernetes, the ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of our platform, demonstrating a strong understanding of system architecture, problem-solving skills, and the ability to guide junior engineers.

As a Platform Engineer within our organization, you will join a team of dedicated unicorns who are focused on advancing freedom and independence globally. In this position, you will be expected to:

jobs.title: EMEA Sales Operations Manager - GTM
jobs.description:
EMEA Sales Operations Manager - GTM

Role Description

We are looking for a data-driven, systems-thinking Sales Operations Manager to own the operating infrastructure that powers our go-to-market engine. In this highly visible Individual Contributor role, you will serve as the backbone of a regional Sales organization and translate go-to-market strategy into an executable operating model.

You will act as the primary regional business partner for sales executives, supporting all routes to market within the region. You will own or coordinate supporting sales planning, territory and quota execution, forecast interpretation, operational improvements, and translation of strategic priorities into clear execution plans.

You’ll drive process clarity, pipeline health, forecasting hygiene, and cross-functional governance, using AI and automation-enabled workflows to reduce manual reporting effort while maintaining strong human judgment over business recommendations. Your top priority each day will be to ensure excellence in execution and reporting on our regional goals.

Responsibilities

  • Own the operating cadence, including territory management, account segmentation, forecasting governance, pipeline inspection, business reviews, and performance visibility, delivering executive-ready insights that drive forecast accuracy, balanced sales coverage, and operational excellence.Partner with regional Sales leaders across all routes to market to improve forecast accuracy, pipeline health, sales coverage, deal quality, and operational execution.
  • Work in close partnership with the Chief Business Officer’s organization and the GTM Strategy & Programs team to connect regional Sales Operations to company-wide priorities, provide timely inputs for executive reporting, and ensure consistency across regional and corporate operating cadences.
  • Lead end-to-end coverage design, including segmentation, book cutting, territory planning, account assignment, capacity planning, and quota allocation in partnership with Sales Leadership, Compensation, Finance, Systems, and Analytics.
  • Own CRM QA and hygiene for the supported region, including SFDC hierarchy management, pipeline quality, process compliance, forecast integrity, deal quality investigations, and exception resolution.
  • Partner with leadership on pipeline inspection, forecasting, and opportunity assessment, and build executive-ready reporting, dashboards, MBR/QBR readouts, and business insights that help leaders identify risks and make better decisions.
  • Partner with Sales Strategy, Systems, Analytics, Compensation, Finance, and Enablement to automate recurring workflows and continuously improve how the team operates.
  • Support organization design, interim coverage plans, role changes, new-hire onboarding, SPIF development and administration, and Channel deal registration as part of the regional operating model.

Requirements

  • Proven experience scaling Sales Operations across Europe, supporting a complex, multi-country sales organization with diverse markets, languages, and evolving go-to-market motions.
  • Professional working proficiency in English is required as this role regularly collaborates with global teams
  • 8+ years of experience in sales operations, business strategy, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or corporate advisory, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • 4+ years of experience working with executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading territory planning, account segmentation, forecasting, pipeline inspection, and annual sales planning processes.
  • Deep understanding of quota planning, sales capacity modeling, and quota governance, with the ability to align quotas to business strategy and commercial objectives.
  • Experience using AI, automation, and analytics tools to improve forecasting, pipeline inspection, reporting, and workflow efficiency, with the ability to validate outputs and apply sound business judgment before making recommendations.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • The role can be based in either the UK or Ireland.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting executive operating cadences (e.g., Weekly Business Reviews, Forecast Calls, Quarterly Business Reviews) for senior sales leadership.
  • Experience designing or optimizing territory, account segmentation, or book-of-business models for high-growth SaaS organizations.
  • Experience developing quota methodologies, allocating quotas, and partnering with Sales Leadership and Finance to align quotas with territory design, capacity planning, and business objectives.
  • Experience supporting multiple sales motions (Direct, Channel, Self-Serve, Enterprise) across global or multi-region organizations.
  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, SQL, or similar business intelligence and CRM platforms.
  • Experience operating in a high-growth or transformational environment where Sales Operations played a strategic role in scaling the business.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer - Mid Level - Actions Team
(Senior) Fund Accounting & Reporting Manager
jobs.description:
(Senior) Fund Accounting & Reporting Manager

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

We are building the next generation of fund services: technology-driven, automated and seamlessly integrated with product & engineering. In close partnership with Moore TK, a leading advisor in tax and accounting for private capital clients, we combine deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology.


For our VC & PE clients, we deliver high-quality investor reporting and financials – fast, standardized, and audit-proof. We rely on modern tools, clean data models and automation instead of Excel overload.We develop an integrated end-to-end operating model (accounting, reporting, tax) – standardized, quality-assured and knowledge-driven – thereby creating a foundation for scalable, future-proof fund services.

Your role
You will take responsibility for fund accounting and investor reporting for selected VC/PE funds - delivered on time, accurately, and in full compliance with Invest Europe standards. You are more than just a numbers expert: you ensure transparency and trust among fund managers, LPs, and investment teams, making the success of our funds visible.

With your eye for efficiency, you will actively drive the automation and digitization of our processes and work with us to shape the next stage of development for our services. Quality, responsibility and progress are not buzzwords to you, they’re what truly motivate you.

What You’ll Do

  • Preparation of accurate investor reports including performance metrics (IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVP, etc.), NAV and carried interest calculations. Ensuring compliance with the Invest Europe guidelines and handling ad-hoc enquiries.

  • Responsibility for annual financial statements including notes, close coordination with auditors, monitoring of quality and timelines as well as risk-oriented reviews.

  • Conduct reviews of accounting data, reconciliations and valuation checks, while continuously improving our quality assurance process.

  • Collaboration with product and engineering teams to further standardise and automate our processes.

  • Support portfolio valuations, waterfall calculations and reviews of capital calls, distributions and management fee calculations.

  • Proactive, reliable communication with GPs, LPs and internal teams (operations, tech).

  • Work closely with the tax team on tax-related matters and ensure consistency between accounting, tax ledger and investor reporting.

About you

  • Degree in accounting, finance or controlling (or equivalent)

  • 5 years of relevant experience in fund accounting/administration (alternative investments). Experience in integrated setups involving operations, accounting/reporting and tax is a plus.

  • Solid knowledge of Local GAAP and IFRS, experience with further standards (e.g., Luxembourg, US) and audit experience are advantageous.

  • Practical experience with Invest Europe Guidelines and strong command of reporting processes.

  • High IT affinity, experienced in fund-reporting software, advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills; interest in using project management software is a plus.

  • Analytical, detail-oriented, dynamic, deadline-driven and eager to learn continuously.

  • Proficiency in English; German a strong advantage.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Take part in a network of people passionate about investment and work closely with the most interesting players in the private market.

  • Benefit from working with a diverse mix of talents, unrivalled energy, and team spirit within a culture of drive and ownership

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid office setup (3 days/week in office)

  • 6 remote calendar weeks/year

  • 30 days of vacation, 2 company days, plus local public holidays

  • A competitive compensation package

  • A great tech and work setup with everything you need

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

jobs.title: Werkstudent / Praktikant Content Marketing & Communications
jobs.description:
Werkstudent / Praktikant Content Marketing & Communications

Über uns

toern ist ein wachsendes AI-Startup aus Hamburg, das den Retourenprozess im E-Commerce neu denkt. Mit unserer automatisierten All-in-One-Lösung helfen wir Shopify-Shops wie Saint Sass, NINETY-9 oder dem 1. FC Köln, Rückgaben effizienter zu managen, Prozesse zu vereinfachen und aus Retourendaten wertvolle Business-Insights zu gewinnen.

Wir wollen, dass E-Commerce-Brands toern überall finden, wo sie nach einer Retourenlösung suchen – bei Google, auf LinkedIn oder in ChatGPT. Dafür bauen wir unseren Content- und Marketingbereich weiter aus.

Du hast Lust, spannende Geschichten zu erzählen, kreative Inhalte zu entwickeln und Marketing aktiv mitzugestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns Content und Kommunikation für die Ära der KI-Suche!

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest direkt mit Alena, unserer Gründerin, und Rike, unserer Marketing Managerin, zusammen. Dabei übernimmst du eigene Projekte und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

Website & Content: Du schreibst und optimierst Landingpages, Blogartikel und Ratgeber rund um Retouren, Shopify und E-Commerce-Operations.

GEO & SEO: Du sorgst dafür, dass toern in KI-Suchen wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Overviews sichtbar wird. Dafür entwickelst du strukturierte Inhalte, FAQs und Vergleichsseiten, beobachtest unsere Sichtbarkeit und leitest Optimierungen ab.

Case Studies & Storytelling: Du führst Interviews mit unseren Kunden, arbeitest spannende Zahlen und Ergebnisse heraus und verwandelst sie in überzeugende Case Studies für Website, Sales und Social Media.

Social Media: Du entwickelst kreative Inhalte für LinkedIn und Instagram – von Posts und Karussells bis hin zu Video-Formaten.

Events & Teamkultur: Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Organisation von Messen und Events, kümmerst dich um die Einladung und Kommunikation mit Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass vor Ort alles rundläuft. Außerdem planst und organisierst du interne Teamevents und bringst eigene Ideen für gemeinsame Aktivitäten ein.

AI im Marketing: Du nutzt AI-Tools aktiv für Recherche, Textentwürfe und Visuals und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue Workflows, um Content smarter und effizienter zu erstellen.

Dein Profil

  • Du studierst Marketing, Kommunikation, Journalismus, Medien, BWL oder etwas Vergleichbares (für das Praktikum ist ein Pflichtpraktikum erforderlich).
  • Du schreibst gerne und kannst komplexe Themen verständlich, kreativ und auf den Punkt bringen.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media und weißt, welche Inhalte auf LinkedIn und Instagram funktionieren.
  • Du interessierst dich für SEO und die Zukunft der Suche durch KI. Erste Erfahrungen mit GEO sind ein Plus.
  • Du bist kreativ und sicher im Umgang mit Tools wie Canva oder Figma. Erste Erfahrungen mit Video-Editing (z. B. CapCut) sind willkommen.
  • Du organisierst gerne, behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick und hast Lust, Events eigenständig mit vorzubereiten.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und hast eine Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Du bist AI-affin und nutzt KI nicht nur als Tool, sondern denkst aktiv mit, wie sich Marketing und Content verbessern kann.
  • Du hast Interesse an E-Commerce, SaaS und der Startup-Welt.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Gründerin: kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch und Verantwortung ab Tag eins.
  • Eigene Projekte & Formate: Deine Ideen werden umgesetzt und deine Inhalte haben einen sichtbaren Impact auf Reichweite und Leads.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung in Content Marketing, GEO, SEO und B2B-Marketing in einem AI-Startup.
  • Einblicke hinter die Kulissen: Du lernst den Aufbau eines Startups kennen und arbeitest an echten Kund aus dem E-Commerce.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir finden ein Modell, das gut zu deinem Studium passt, inklusive Remote-Anteil.
  • Schönes Office: Unser Büro liegt in der Hamburger Speicherstadt inklusive Siebträgermaschine, Snacks und Team-Events.
  • Teamspirit: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, feiern gemeinsame Erfolge und organisieren regelmäßig Aktivitäten als Team.
