jobs.description:
Technical Lead (Core Services)

Technical Lead – Core Services

Build the Future of AI in Financial Services

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows.

We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland’s largest Series A rounds. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our team to meet that demand.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the core services that underpin Aveni’s platform.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role with responsibility for the architecture, quality and operational reliability of the foundations our product teams build upon. You’ll work across areas including client-data ingestion and preprocessing, CRM integrations and APIs, multi-tenancy, identity and authentication, and data lifecycle and retention.

You’ll lead the technical direction of a team of around six to seven engineers, remaining close to the code while making architectural decisions, setting engineering standards and helping other engineers grow.

Our platform supports regulated financial-services organisations, so reliability, security, auditability and data isolation aren’t afterthoughts — they’re fundamental to how we design and build.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Owning the technical architecture and direction of Aveni’s core platform services.

  • Designing and building scalable, event-driven services on AWS.

  • Developing and evolving our client-data ingestion capabilities, enabling new clients and data sources to be onboarded increasingly through configuration rather than bespoke engineering.

  • Building and maintaining APIs that give Aveni products a consistent way to consume client and CRM data.

  • Designing robust multi-tenant systems with strong data isolation, security and operational controls.

  • Leading our approach to data lifecycle management, including retention, deletion, residency and GDPR requirements.

  • Building resilient integrations with third-party platforms and APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, retries, reconciliation and failure recovery.

  • Making and documenting architectural decisions and representing Core Services in Architecture Review Board discussions.

  • Raising engineering standards across testing, observability, security, reliability and operational ownership.

  • Remaining hands-on with production code, primarily across Node.js and AWS.

  • Mentoring engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions and technical coaching.

  • Helping the team make effective use of AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle while maintaining strong engineering judgement and appropriate controls.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Significant software engineering experience, with a strong track record of technical leadership and architectural decision-making.

  • Deep production experience with Node.js, particularly across backend, API and distributed systems.

  • Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native systems on AWS.

  • Experience building event-driven architectures and an understanding of the challenges that come with asynchronous distributed systems.

  • Experience designing production systems with complex multi-tenancy, data isolation or data lifecycle requirements.

  • Strong experience integrating with third-party APIs and designing for rate limits, partial failures, retries and reconciliation.

  • A strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational ownership.

  • Experience making architectural trade-offs and communicating technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.

  • A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards.

  • The ability and desire to remain hands-on while providing technical direction to a team.

Desirable

  • Production experience with Python alongside Node.js.

  • Experience with identity and access management technologies such as Auth0, AWS Cognito or similar.

  • Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0 and authentication/authorisation patterns.

  • Experience building software within financial services or another regulated environment.

  • Experience handling data residency, retention and GDPR erasure requirements at scale.

  • Experience contributing to Architecture Review Boards or similar technical governance forums.

  • Experience establishing or improving AI-assisted software engineering practices.

The Kind of Technical Lead We’re Looking For

We’re not looking for someone who has moved completely away from engineering.

You’ll still design systems, review code, solve difficult technical problems and contribute to production software. At the same time, you’ll create leverage by helping the engineers around you make better decisions and take greater ownership.

You’ll be comfortable asking questions before reaching for a solution, thinking through failure modes as carefully as the happy path, and balancing architectural quality with the realities of delivering software in a fast-growing business.

You don’t need to have used every AWS service or technology in our stack. What matters more is that you understand the underlying engineering problems, can explain the trade-offs behind your decisions, and have successfully operated the systems you’ve helped design.

  • Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

  • Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI.

  • Build intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial services.

  • Maintain and evolve BJAK's design system to ensure consistency across products.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to deliver pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing.

  • Ensure accessibility, responsiveness and visual consistency across different devices and platforms.

  • Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts.

  • Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design.

  • Ability to simplify complex user journeys into intuitive interfaces.

  • High attention to detail with strong visual hierarchy, typography and spacing.

  • Portfolio is required. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Design Tools

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout & Components

  • Design Tokens

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in complete user journeys, not just beautiful screens.

  • Obsesses over clarity, consistency and usability.

  • Designs interfaces that reduce friction and build user trust.

  • Works closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Moves quickly while maintaining a high standard of visual quality.

  • Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers who focus only on aesthetics without considering usability.

  • People who copy trends without understanding user problems.

  • Designers who struggle to collaborate with product and engineering teams.

  • Individuals who require extensive direction before making design decisions.

Location

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Policy Manager
jobs.description:
Policy Manager

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

As Plaid’s Public Policy Manager for the UK and EU, you’ll lead our policy work across both regions, partnering closely with our Head of Policy and Head of Europe Legal and Compliance. You’ll advocate for a secure, consumer-friendly financial ecosystem where people can use their financial data to access the products and services they need. The work spans some of the most important and fast-moving issues in financial services, from cybersecurity and privacy to data use and competition.

We’re looking for a resourceful, strategic thinker who reads political and regulatory dynamics well and finds a way forward. You’ll translate technical and business concepts into clear, actionable policy positions that help grow Plaid’s business and benefit our customers and the consumers they serve. If you’re high-agency, creative in your approach, and known for exceptional follow-through, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own relationships with regulators, government officials, and legislators across the UK and EU, as well as consumer groups, trade associations, financial institutions, and other key stakeholders.

  • Represent Plaid in industry working groups and policy forums on open banking, open finance, smart data, payments, security, and privacy, making Plaid’s case and spotting opportunities to shape the conversation.

  • Lead research and analysis that shapes Plaid’s positions on key issues and informs our regulatory engagement and advocacy.

  • Own the planning and execution of Plaid’s UK and EU policy agenda, coordinating projects with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Partner with teams across Legal, Compliance, Communications, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Sales on shared initiatives.

  • Stay ahead of emerging policy trends in the UK and EU, flagging risks and opportunities for Plaid’s business and recommending strategies for engagement.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in UK or EU financial services policy, for example at a regulator such as the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), in government (such as HM Treasury), in Parliament, at a financial services trade association, or in-house.

  • Strong existing relationships with policymakers, regulators, financial institutions, trade associations, think tanks, and consumer groups in the UK or EU.

  • A proven track record of advocacy and policy influence within financial services.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders, including those across the political spectrum.

  • A resourceful, adaptable, and collaborative approach, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves.

  • Curiosity about product, technology, and AI.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Policy experience across both the UK and EU.

  • Experience working on open banking, open finance, payments, or data-sharing policy.

  • Based in London.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.
